translations.idiomatic: Procedure for computing lunar eclipses

sentences.zh: 求天正冬至，

translations.literal: To find civil-year winter solstice,
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the civil year (as in the jiazi epoch method),

sentences.zh: 求紀日，

translations.literal: To find cycle days,
translations.idiomatic: To find the cycle-day count (as in the jiazi epoch method),

sentences.zh: 求首朔，

translations.literal: To find epoch new moon,
translations.idiomatic: To find the epoch new moon (as in the jiazi epoch method),

sentences.zh: 求太陰入食限，並同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find moon entering eclipse limit, all same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To determine whether the moon enters the eclipse zone, use the same method as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 視某月太陰平交周入可食之限，即為有食之月。

translations.literal: Inspect a given month's moon mean nodal longitude entering the edible limit, then that is the month having eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If in a given month the moon's mean nodal longitude falls within the eclipse zone, that month will have an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交周自五宮十四度五十一分至六宮十五度九分，自十一宮十四度五十一分至初宮十五度九分，皆可食之限。

translations.literal: Nodal longitude from fifth mansion 14°51′ to sixth mansion 15°09′, from eleventh mansion 14°51′ to first mansion 15°09′, all are edible limits.
translations.idiomatic: The eclipse zone extends from 14°51′ in the fifth mansion to 15°09′ in the sixth, and from 14°51′ in the eleventh mansion to 15°09′ in the first.

sentences.zh: 再於實時距正交詳之。

translations.literal: Further examine it at true time's distance from true node.
translations.idiomatic: Refine this at the true time by the distance from the true node.

sentences.zh: 求平望，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find mean full moon, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean full moon, use the same method as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 求實望實時，先求泛時，用兩日實行較，同甲子元求朔望法。

translations.literal: To find true full moon true time, first find approximate time, use two-day true motion comparison, same as jiazi epoch method for finding new and full moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true time of full moon, first find the approximate time by comparing true motions over two days—by the same method as in the jiazi epoch system for new and full moon.

sentences.zh: 次設前、後兩時，各求日、月黃道實行。

translations.literal: Next set forward and backward two times, each seek sun and moon ecliptic true motion.
translations.idiomatic: Next set two times before and after, and compute the true ecliptic longitudes of the sun and moon at each.

sentences.zh: 復用兩時實行較，得實望實時。

translations.literal: Again use two times' true motion comparison, obtaining true full moon true time.
translations.idiomatic: By comparing true motions at the two times, obtain the true time of full moon.

sentences.zh: 又以實時各求日、月黃道實行，視本時月距正交入限為有食。

translations.literal: Further at true time each seek sun and moon ecliptic true motion, inspect this time moon's distance from true node entering limit as having eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the true time, compute the true ecliptic longitudes of the sun and moon; if the moon's distance from the true node at that instant falls within the limit, an eclipse occurs.

sentences.zh: 自五宮十七度四十三分至六宮十二度十七分，自十一宮十七度四十三分至初宮十二度十七分，皆有食之限。

translations.literal: From fifth mansion 17°43′ to sixth mansion 12°17′, from eleventh mansion 17°43′ to first mansion 12°17′, all are limits for having eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At true time the eclipse limits are from 17°43′ in the fifth mansion to 12°17′ in the sixth, and from 17°43′ in the eleventh mansion to 12°17′ in the first.

sentences.zh: 求實望用時，用實時太陽均數及升度求法，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find true full-moon apparent time, use true-time sun equation and rising-degree method, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent time of true full moon, compute the sun's equation of center at true time and the rising-degree correction by the same method as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 比視日出入亦同。

translations.literal: Comparison with viewing sun rise and set is also the same.
translations.idiomatic: The comparison with sunrise and sunset is the same as well.

sentences.zh: 求食甚時刻，用平三角形，以一小時太陰白道實行化秒為一邊，本時次時二實行較。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse time, use plane triangle, one hour moon white-path true motion converted to seconds as one side, this time and next time two true motions compared.
translations.idiomatic: To find the time of greatest eclipse, by plane triangle: convert the moon's hourly true motion along the white path to seconds as one side, and compare true motions at the current and following hours.

sentences.zh: 一小時太陽黃道實行化秒為一邊，實望黃白大距為所夾之角，求得對小邊之角為斜距交角差。

translations.literal: One hour sun ecliptic true motion converted to seconds as one side, true full moon great ecliptic-lunar distance as the enclosed angle, the angle opposite the smaller side obtained is oblique-separation nodal-angle difference.
translations.idiomatic: Use the sun's hourly true ecliptic motion in seconds as the other side and the great ecliptic-lunar distance at true full moon as the included angle; the angle opposite the shorter side is the oblique-separation nodal-angle correction.

sentences.zh: 以加實時黃白大距，為斜距黃道交角。

translations.literal: Add to true-time great ecliptic-lunar distance, as oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle.
translations.idiomatic: Add this to the true-time great ecliptic-lunar distance to obtain the oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle.

sentences.zh: 又以斜距交角差之正弦為一率，一小時太陽實行為二率，實望黃白大距之正弦為三率，求得四率，為一小時兩經斜距。

translations.literal: Further oblique-separation nodal-angle difference's sine as first ratio, one hour sun true motion as second, true full moon great ecliptic-lunar distance's sine as third, fourth ratio obtained, as one hour's two-longitude oblique separation.
translations.idiomatic: Use the sine of the oblique-separation nodal-angle correction, the sun's hourly true motion, and the sine of the great ecliptic-lunar distance at true full moon; the fourth ratio is the hourly oblique separation of the two longitudes.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑千萬為一率，斜距黃道交角之餘弦、正弦各為二率，實望月離黃道實緯為三率，各求得四率，為食甚實緯南北與實望黃道實緯同。

translations.literal: Further radius ten million as first ratio, oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle's cosine and sine each as second, true full moon moon's distance from ecliptic true latitude as third, each fourth ratio obtained, as greatest-eclipse true latitude north-south same as true full moon ecliptic true latitude.
translations.idiomatic: Use the radius of ten million, the cosine and sine of the oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle, and the moon's true ecliptic latitude at true full moon; the results give the north-south true latitude at greatest eclipse, equal to the true ecliptic latitude at true full moon.

sentences.zh: 及距弧。

translations.literal: And interval arc.
translations.idiomatic: And the interval arc.

sentences.zh: 又以一小時兩經斜距為一率，一小時化秒為二率，食甚距弧為三率，求得四率為食甚距時。

translations.literal: Further one hour's two-longitude oblique separation as first ratio, one hour in seconds as second, greatest-eclipse interval arc as third, fourth ratio is greatest-eclipse interval time.
translations.idiomatic: Use the hourly oblique separation of the two longitudes, one hour in seconds, and the interval arc at greatest eclipse; the fourth ratio is the interval time to greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以加減實望用時，月距正交初宮、六宮為減，五宮、十一宮為加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from true full-moon apparent time; moon's distance from true node at first and sixth mansions subtract, fifth and eleventh mansions add.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this from the apparent time of true full moon: subtract when the moon is at the first or sixth mansion from the true node, add at the fifth or eleventh.

sentences.zh: 得食甚時刻。

translations.literal: Greatest-eclipse time is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the time of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求太陽太陰實引，置實望太陽引數，加減本時太陽均數，得太陽實引。

translations.literal: To find sun and moon true anomaly: set true full-moon sun anomaly, add or subtract this time's sun equation, obtaining sun true anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's and moon's true anomalies: take the sun's anomaly at true full moon and apply the equation of center at the current time to obtain the sun's true anomaly.

sentences.zh: 又置實望太陰引數，加減本時太陰初均數，得太陰實引。

translations.literal: Further set true full-moon moon anomaly, add or subtract this time's moon first equation, obtaining moon true anomaly.
translations.idiomatic: Take the moon's anomaly at true full moon and apply the moon's first equation at the current time to obtain the moon's true anomaly.

sentences.zh: 求實影半徑，以太陰距地為一率，中距太陰距地為二率，中距太陰最大地半徑差為三率，求得四率為本時太陰最大地半徑差。

translations.literal: To find true shadow semidiameter: moon geocentric distance as first ratio, mean-distance moon geocentric distance as second, mean-distance moon maximum diurnal parallax as third, fourth ratio is this time's moon maximum diurnal parallax.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true umbral radius: use the moon's geocentric distance, the mean-distance lunar distance, and the moon's maximum diurnal parallax at mean distance; the fourth ratio is the moon's maximum parallax at the current time.

sentences.zh: 又以六十九除之，為影差。

translations.literal: Further divide by sixty-nine, as shadow difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by sixty-nine to obtain the shadow correction.

sentences.zh: 又以太陽距地為一率，中距太陽距地為二率，中距太陽視半徑為三率，求得四率為太陽視半徑，與本時太陰最大地半徑差相減。

translations.literal: Further sun geocentric distance as first ratio, mean-distance sun geocentric distance as second, mean-distance sun apparent semidiameter as third, fourth ratio is sun apparent semidiameter, subtract with this time's moon maximum diurnal parallax.
translations.idiomatic: Use the sun's geocentric distance, the mean-distance solar distance, and the sun's apparent semidiameter at mean distance; subtract the result from the moon's maximum parallax at the current time.

sentences.zh: 又加太陽最大地半徑差，為影半徑，又加影差，為實影半徑。

translations.literal: Further add sun maximum diurnal parallax, as shadow semidiameter; further add shadow difference, as true shadow semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: Add the sun's maximum parallax to obtain the shadow semidiameter; add the shadow correction to obtain the true umbral semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 求太陰視半徑，以太陰距地為一率，中距太陰距地為二率，中距太陰視半徑為三率，求得四率，為太陰視半徑。

translations.literal: To find moon apparent semidiameter: moon geocentric distance as first ratio, mean-distance moon geocentric distance as second, mean-distance moon apparent semidiameter as third, fourth ratio obtained, is moon apparent semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's apparent semidiameter: use the moon's geocentric distance, the mean-distance lunar distance, and the moon's apparent semidiameter at mean distance.

sentences.zh: 知

translations.literal: Knowing:
translations.idiomatic: With these known:

sentences.zh: 求食分，以太陰全徑為一率，十分化作六百秒為二率，並徑實影視太陰兩半徑並。

translations.literal: To find eclipse magnitude: moon full diameter as first ratio, ten parts converted to six hundred seconds as second, combined diameter of true shadow and apparent moon two semidiameters joined.
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse magnitude: use the moon's full diameter as the first ratio and ten tenths (600 seconds) as the second; the third ratio is the sum of the true shadow and lunar semidiameters.

sentences.zh: 內減食甚實緯，餘化秒為三率，求得四率為秒，以分收之，即食分。

translations.literal: Subtract inward greatest-eclipse true latitude, remainder converted to seconds as third ratio, fourth ratio in seconds, reduce by minutes, namely eclipse magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the true latitude at greatest eclipse; convert the remainder to seconds as the third ratio; reduce the fourth ratio to minutes to obtain the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓時刻，以並徑與食甚實緯相加化秒為首率，相減化秒為末率，求得中率為秒，以分收之，為初虧、復圓距弧。

translations.literal: To find first-contact and last-contact times: combined diameter with greatest-eclipse true latitude added, converted to seconds as first ratio, subtracted converted to seconds as last ratio, middle ratio in seconds obtained, reduce by minutes, as first-contact and last-contact interval arcs.
translations.idiomatic: To find the times of first and last contact: add and subtract the combined diameter and the true latitude at greatest eclipse, convert to seconds as first and last ratios; convert the middle ratio to minutes as the contact interval arcs.

sentences.zh: 又以一小時兩經斜距為一率，一小時化秒為二率，初虧、復圓距弧為三率，求得四率為初虧、復圓距時，以加減食甚時刻，得初虧、復圓時刻。

translations.literal: Further one hour's two-longitude oblique separation as first ratio, one hour in seconds as second, first-contact and last-contact interval arcs as third, fourth ratio is first-contact and last-contact interval times, add or subtract from greatest-eclipse time, obtaining first-contact and last-contact times.
translations.idiomatic: Use the hourly oblique separation, one hour in seconds, and the contact interval arcs; apply the resulting interval times to the time of greatest eclipse to obtain the times of first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 減得初虧，加得復圓。

translations.literal: Subtract to obtain first contact, add to obtain last contact.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for first contact; add for last contact.

sentences.zh: 求食既、生光時刻，以兩徑較實影視太陰兩半徑相減之餘。

translations.literal: To find totality-beginning and light-return times: the remainder of true shadow and apparent moon two semidiameters compared and subtracted.
translations.idiomatic: To find the times when totality begins and light returns: take the difference of the two semidiameters—the true shadow and the lunar semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 與食甚實緯相加化秒為首率，相減化秒為末率，求得中率為秒，以分收之，為食既、生光距弧。

translations.literal: With greatest-eclipse true latitude added converted to seconds as first ratio, subtracted converted to seconds as last ratio, middle ratio in seconds obtained, reduce by minutes, as totality and light-return interval arcs.
translations.idiomatic: Add and subtract this from the true latitude at greatest eclipse and convert to seconds as first and last ratios; convert the middle ratio to minutes as the totality interval arcs.

sentences.zh: 求距時時刻，與初虧、復圓法同。

translations.literal: To find interval times, same as first-contact and last-contact method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval times, use the same method as for first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 食在十分以內，則無此二限。

translations.literal: Eclipse within ten tenths, then there are not these two limits.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse magnitude is less than ten tenths, these two limits do not apply.

sentences.zh: 求食限總時，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find total eclipse duration, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the total duration of the eclipse, use the same method as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 求食甚太陰黃道經緯宿度，以一小時化秒為一率，一小時太陰白道實行為二率，食甚距時化秒為三率，求得四率，為距時月實行。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse moon ecliptic longitude, latitude, and mansion position: one hour in seconds as first ratio, one hour moon white-path true motion as second, greatest-eclipse interval time in seconds as third, fourth ratio obtained, as interval-time moon true motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's ecliptic longitude, latitude, and mansion at greatest eclipse: use one hour in seconds, the moon's hourly true motion along the white path, and the interval time to greatest eclipse in seconds; the fourth ratio is the moon's true motion over that interval.

sentences.zh: 以加減實望太陰白道實行，加減與食甚距時同。

translations.literal: Add or subtract to true full-moon moon white-path true motion; addition and subtraction same as greatest-eclipse interval time.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this from the moon's true white-path longitude at true full moon, with the same sign as the interval time to greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 得食甚太陰白道經度。

translations.literal: Moon white-path longitude at greatest eclipse is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the moon's white-path longitude at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 又置實望月距正交，加減距時月實行，得食甚月距正交。

translations.literal: Further set true full-moon moon's distance from true node, add or subtract interval-time moon true motion, obtaining greatest-eclipse moon's distance from true node.
translations.idiomatic: Take the moon's distance from the true node at true full moon and apply the interval motion to obtain the distance from the true node at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 再求黃道經緯宿度，同月離。

translations.literal: Again find ecliptic longitude, latitude, and mansion position, same as lunar distance section.
translations.idiomatic: Then compute the ecliptic longitude, latitude, and mansion by the same method as in the lunar-distance section.

sentences.zh: 求食甚太陰赤道經緯宿度，以半徑千萬為一率，食甚太陰距春、秋分黃道經度正弦為二率，食甚太陰黃道經度不及三宮者，與三宮相減；

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse moon equatorial longitude, latitude, and mansion position: radius ten million as first ratio, greatest-eclipse moon distance from spring/autumn equinox ecliptic longitude sine as second, greatest-eclipse moon ecliptic longitude not reaching three mansions, subtract from three mansions;
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's equatorial longitude, latitude, and mansion at greatest eclipse: use the radius of ten million and the sine of the moon's ecliptic longitude measured from the equinox; if the moon's ecliptic longitude is less than three mansions, subtract from three mansions;

sentences.zh: 過三宮者，減三宮；

translations.literal: exceeding three mansions, subtract three mansions;
translations.idiomatic: if greater than three mansions, subtract three mansions;

sentences.zh: 過六宮者，與九宮相減；

translations.literal: exceeding six mansions, subtract from nine mansions;
translations.idiomatic: if greater than six mansions, subtract from nine mansions;

sentences.zh: 過九宮者，減九宮。

translations.literal: exceeding nine mansions, subtract nine mansions.
translations.idiomatic: if greater than nine mansions, subtract nine mansions.

sentences.zh: 食甚太陰黃道緯度餘切為三率，求得四率為餘切，檢表得太陰距二分弧與黃道交角，以加減黃赤大距，食甚太陰黃道經度九宮至三宮，緯南加，緯北減，皆在赤道南，反減則在北。

translations.literal: Greatest-eclipse moon ecliptic latitude cotangent as third ratio, fourth ratio is cotangent, look up table for moon distance from solstitial arc with ecliptic angle; add or subtract ecliptic-equator great distance; greatest-eclipse moon ecliptic longitude ninth mansion to third mansion: south latitude add, north latitude subtract, all on equator south, reverse subtract then on north.
translations.idiomatic: Use the cotangent of the moon's ecliptic latitude at greatest eclipse as the third ratio; look up the moon's angle with the solstitial arc in the tables; add or subtract the great ecliptic-equator distance—for ecliptic longitudes from the ninth to the third mansion, add for south latitude and subtract for north (all on the south side of the equator; reverse for the north).

sentences.zh: 三宮至九宮加減反是。

translations.literal: Third mansion to ninth mansion: add and subtract reverse.
translations.idiomatic: From the third to the ninth mansion, reverse the addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 為太陰距二分弧與赤道交角。

translations.literal: This is moon's distance from solstitial arc with equator angle.
translations.idiomatic: This is the moon's angle with the equator measured from the solstitial arc.

sentences.zh: 又以太陰距二分弧與黃道交角之餘弦為一率，半徑千萬為二率，食甚太陰距春、秋分黃道經度之正切為三率，求得四率，為太陰距二分弧之正切。

translations.literal: Further moon distance from solstitial arc with ecliptic angle's cosine as first ratio, radius ten million as second, greatest-eclipse moon distance from spring/autumn equinox ecliptic longitude tangent as third, fourth ratio obtained, as moon distance from solstitial arc tangent.
translations.idiomatic: Use the cosine of the moon's angle with the solstitial arc on the ecliptic, the radius of ten million, and the tangent of the moon's ecliptic longitude from the equinox; the fourth ratio is the tangent of the moon's distance from the solstitial arc.

sentences.zh: 又以半徑千萬為一率，太陰距二分弧與赤道交角之餘弦為二率，太陰距二分弧正切為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表為距春、秋分赤道經度。

translations.literal: Further radius ten million as first ratio, moon distance from solstitial arc with equator angle's cosine as second, moon distance from solstitial arc tangent as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for distance from spring/autumn equinox equatorial longitude.
translations.idiomatic: Use the radius of ten million, the cosine of the moon's angle with the solstitial arc on the equator, and the tangent of the distance from the solstitial arc; look up the result to obtain the equatorial longitude from the equinox.

sentences.zh: 加減三宮九宮，食甚太陰黃道經度不及三宮，與三宮相減，過三宮者加三宮。

translations.literal: Add or subtract three and nine mansions; greatest-eclipse moon ecliptic longitude not reaching three mansions, subtract from three mansions; exceeding three mansions, add three mansions.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the three- and nine-mansion corrections: if the ecliptic longitude is less than three mansions, subtract from three mansions; if greater, add three mansions.

sentences.zh: 過六宮者，與九宮相減，過九宮者加九宮。

translations.literal: Exceeding six mansions, subtract from nine mansions; exceeding nine mansions, add nine mansions.
translations.idiomatic: If greater than six mansions, subtract from nine; if greater than nine mansions, add nine.

sentences.zh: 得食甚太陰赤道經度。

translations.literal: Moon equatorial longitude at greatest eclipse is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the moon's equatorial longitude at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求緯度宿度，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find latitude and mansion position, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the latitude and mansion, use the same method as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓黃道高弧交角，以半徑千萬為一率，黃赤大距正弦為二率，影距春、秋分黃道經度正弦為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得影距赤道度。

translations.literal: To find first-contact and last-contact ecliptic altitude arc angles: radius ten million as first ratio, ecliptic-equator great distance sine as second, shadow distance from spring/autumn equinox ecliptic longitude sine as third, fourth ratio is sine, look up table for shadow distance equatorial degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic altitude arc angles at first and last contact: use the radius of ten million, the sine of the great ecliptic-equator distance, and the sine of the shadow's ecliptic longitude from the equinox; look up the result to obtain the shadow's equatorial distance.

sentences.zh: 影距春、秋分度數與太陽同，太陽在赤道北，影在南，太陽在赤道南，影在北。

translations.literal: Shadow distance from spring/autumn equinox degrees same as sun; sun on equator north, shadow on south; sun on equator south, shadow on north.
translations.idiomatic: The shadow's distance from the equinox matches the sun's: when the sun is north of the equator the shadow is south, and when the sun is south the shadow is north.

sentences.zh: 又以影距春、秋分黃道經度餘弦為一率，黃赤大距餘切為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表為黃道赤經交角。

translations.literal: Further shadow distance from spring/autumn equinox ecliptic longitude cosine as first ratio, ecliptic-equator great distance cotangent as second, radius ten million as third, fourth ratio is tangent, look up table for ecliptic-equator right-ascension angle.
translations.idiomatic: Use the cosine of the shadow's ecliptic longitude from the equinox, the cotangent of the great ecliptic-equator distance, and the radius of ten million; look up the resulting tangent to obtain the ecliptic-equator right-ascension angle.

sentences.zh: 乃用弧三角形，以北極距天頂為一邊，影距赤道與九十度相加減為一邊，北則減，南則加。

translations.literal: Then use spherical triangle, north pole distance to zenith as one side, shadow equatorial distance with ninety degrees added or subtracted as one side; north then subtract, south then add.
translations.idiomatic: Then by spherical triangle: use the distance from the north pole to the zenith as one side and the shadow's equatorial distance plus or minus ninety degrees as the other—subtract for north, add for south.

sentences.zh: 初虧、復圓各子正時刻過十二時者，與二十四時相減。

translations.literal: First contact and last contact each at midnight time exceeding twelve hours, subtract from twenty-four hours.
translations.idiomatic: For first and last contact, if the midnight time exceeds twelve hours, subtract from twenty-four hours.

sentences.zh: 變赤道度，各為所夾之角，求得對北極距天頂之角。

translations.literal: Convert equatorial degrees, each as the enclosed angle, obtain the angle opposite the north-pole-to-zenith side.
translations.idiomatic: Convert to equatorial degrees as the included angle and obtain the angle opposite the north-pole-to-zenith side.

sentences.zh: 各為赤經高弧交角，以加減黃道赤經交角，太陰在夏至前六宮，食在子正後則減，為限西。

translations.literal: Each as equatorial right-ascension altitude arc angle, add or subtract ecliptic-equator right-ascension angle; moon before summer solstice in six mansions, eclipse after midnight subtract, as limit west.
translations.idiomatic: Each gives an equatorial altitude arc angle; add or subtract the ecliptic-equator right-ascension angle—for the moon before summer solstice in the first six mansions, subtract if the eclipse is after midnight (western limit).

sentences.zh: 食在子正前則加，加過九十度，與半周相減，為限東。

translations.literal: Eclipse before midnight then add; if addition exceeds ninety degrees, subtract from semicircle, as limit east.
translations.idiomatic: Add if the eclipse is before midnight; if the sum exceeds ninety degrees, subtract from a semicircle for the eastern limit.

sentences.zh: 不及九十度，則不與半周相減，變為限西。

translations.literal: Not reaching ninety degrees, then do not subtract from semicircle, change to limit west.
translations.idiomatic: If less than ninety degrees, do not subtract from a semicircle; this becomes the western limit.

sentences.zh: 在夏至後六宮反是。

translations.literal: After summer solstice in six mansions the reverse holds.
translations.idiomatic: After summer solstice in the last six mansions, reverse the rule.

sentences.zh: 各得黃道高弧交角。

translations.literal: Each obtains ecliptic altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the ecliptic altitude arc angle for each contact.

sentences.zh: 若食在子正，影在正午，無赤經高弧交角，則黃道赤經交角即黃道高弧交角。

translations.literal: If eclipse at midnight, shadow at noon, no equatorial right-ascension altitude arc angle, then ecliptic-equator right-ascension angle is the ecliptic altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse is at midnight and the shadow at noon, there is no equatorial altitude arc angle; the ecliptic-equator right-ascension angle is then the ecliptic altitude arc angle.

sentences.zh: 太陰在夏至前為限西，後為限東。

translations.literal: Moon before summer solstice is limit west, after is limit east.
translations.idiomatic: Before summer solstice the limit is west; after, east.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓並徑高弧交角，以並徑為一率，食甚實緯為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率為餘弦，檢表為並徑交實緯角。

translations.literal: To find first-contact and last-contact combined-diameter altitude arc angles: combined diameter as first ratio, greatest-eclipse true latitude as second, radius ten million as third, fourth ratio is cosine, look up table as combined-diameter with true-latitude angle.
translations.idiomatic: To find the combined-diameter altitude arc angles at first and last contact: use the combined diameter, the true latitude at greatest eclipse, and the radius of ten million; look up the cosine to obtain the angle between the combined diameter and the true latitude.

sentences.zh: 如無食甚實緯，即無此角，亦無並徑黃道交角。

translations.literal: If no greatest-eclipse true latitude, then there is not this angle, also no combined-diameter ecliptic angle.
translations.idiomatic: If there is no true latitude at greatest eclipse, this angle and the combined-diameter ecliptic angle do not exist.

sentences.zh: 又置九十度，加減斜距黃道交角，得初虧、復圓黃道交實緯角。

translations.literal: Further set ninety degrees, add or subtract oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle, obtaining first-contact and last-contact ecliptic with true-latitude angle.
translations.idiomatic: Set ninety degrees and add or subtract the oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle to obtain the ecliptic angles with true latitude at first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 食甚月距正交初宮、六宮，初虧減，復圓加。

translations.literal: Greatest-eclipse moon's distance from true node at first and sixth mansions: first contact subtract, last contact add.
translations.idiomatic: At greatest eclipse, if the moon is at the first or sixth mansion from the true node: subtract for first contact, add for last contact.

sentences.zh: 五宮、十一宮，初虧加，復圓減。

translations.literal: Fifth and eleventh mansions: first contact add, last contact subtract.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth or eleventh mansion: add for first contact, subtract for last contact.

sentences.zh: 各與並徑交實緯角相減，為初虧、復圓並徑黃道交角。

translations.literal: Each subtract with combined-diameter with true-latitude angle, as first-contact and last-contact combined-diameter ecliptic angle.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract each from the combined-diameter with true-latitude angle to obtain the combined-diameter ecliptic angles at first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 並徑初交實緯角小，距緯南北與食甚同。

translations.literal: Combined-diameter initial with true-latitude angle small, latitude distance north-south same as greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If the initial combined-diameter with true-latitude angle is small, the north-south latitude distance matches that at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 大則反是。

translations.literal: Large then the reverse holds.
translations.idiomatic: If large, the reverse holds.

sentences.zh: 以加減黃道高弧交角，虧限東，復圓限西，緯南加，緯北減。

translations.literal: Add or subtract ecliptic altitude arc angle; eclipse limit east, last contact limit west; south latitude add, north latitude subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the ecliptic altitude arc angle: for the eastern eclipse limit and western last-contact limit, add for south latitude and subtract for north.

sentences.zh: 初虧限西，復圓限東，加減反是。

translations.literal: First contact limit west, last contact limit east, add-subtract is reversed.
translations.idiomatic: For the western limit at first contact and the eastern limit at last contact, reverse the addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 各得並徑高弧交角。

translations.literal: Each obtains combined-diameter altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: Each yields the combined-diameter altitude arc angle.

sentences.zh: 如無並徑黃道交角，則黃道高弧交角即並徑高弧交角。

translations.literal: If there is no combined-diameter ecliptic angle, then ecliptic altitude arc angle is the combined-diameter altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: If there is no combined-diameter ecliptic angle, the ecliptic altitude arc angle equals the combined-diameter altitude arc angle.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓方位，即以並徑高弧交角為定交角，求法同甲子元。

translations.literal: To find first contact and last contact orientation, then use combined-diameter altitude arc angle as fixed contact angle, method same as jiazi epoch.
translations.idiomatic: To find the orientation at first and last contact, take the combined-diameter altitude arc angle as the fixed contact angle; the method is the same as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 但以並徑高弧交角初度初虧在限東為正下，限西為正上；

translations.literal: But with combined-diameter altitude arc angle initial degree, first contact at eastern limit is directly below, at western limit is directly above;
translations.idiomatic: But at the initial degree of the combined-diameter altitude arc angle: first contact at the eastern limit is directly below, at the western limit directly above;

sentences.zh: 復圓在限東為正上，限西為正下。

translations.literal: Last contact at eastern limit is directly above, at western limit is directly below.
translations.idiomatic: At last contact, the eastern limit is directly above and the western limit directly below.

sentences.zh: 據京師北極高度定，與甲子元法同。

translations.literal: Determine according to the capital's polar altitude, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: Determine the orientation from the capital's polar altitude, as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求帶食分秒，用兩經斜距，不用月距日實行，餘與甲子元法同。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse magnitude, use two-nodal oblique separation, not use moon-sun true motion, remainder same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the magnitude of a horizon eclipse, use the two-nodal oblique separation rather than the moon-sun true motion; the remaining steps follow the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求帶食方位，用帶食兩心相距，不用並徑求諸交角，如初虧、復圓定方位。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse orientation, use horizon-eclipse two-center separation, not use combined diameter to find various nodal angles, like first contact and last contact fix orientation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the horizon-eclipse orientation, use the center separation at the horizon rather than deriving the various nodal angles from the combined diameter, as for fixing the orientation at first and last contact.

sentences.zh: 食甚前與初虧同，食甚後與復圓同。

translations.literal: Before greatest eclipse same as first contact, after greatest eclipse same as last contact.
translations.idiomatic: Before greatest eclipse, use the same rules as for first contact; after greatest eclipse, the same as for last contact.

sentences.zh: 求各省月食時刻方位，理同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find each province's lunar-eclipse time and orientation, principle same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the time and orientation of the lunar eclipse for each province, the principle is the same as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 繪月食圖，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Draw lunar-eclipse diagram, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: The method for drawing the lunar eclipse diagram is the same as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 日食用數

translations.literal: Constants used for solar eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Constants for solar eclipse calculation

sentences.zh: 太陽光分一十五秒，餘見日躔、月離、月食。

translations.literal: Sun light-semidiameter fifteen seconds; remainder see solar motion, lunar distance, and lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Solar limb (light-semidiameter): 15″; for the remaining constants, see the sections on solar motion, lunar distance, and lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 推日食法

translations.literal: Method for computing solar eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for computing solar eclipses

sentences.zh: 求天正冬至，

translations.literal: To find civil-year winter solstice,
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice of the civil year,

sentences.zh: 求紀日，

translations.literal: To find cycle days,
translations.idiomatic: To find the cycle-day count,

sentences.zh: 求首朔，

translations.literal: To find epoch new moon,
translations.idiomatic: To find the epoch new moon,

sentences.zh: 求太陰入食限，並同月食，惟不用望策，即為逐月朔太陰交周。

translations.literal: To find moon entering eclipse limit, all same as lunar eclipse, only without full-moon interval, thus each month's new-moon moon nodal longitude.
translations.idiomatic: To determine whether the moon enters the eclipse zone, use the same method as for lunar eclipses, but without the half-month interval—this gives the moon's nodal longitude at each new moon.

sentences.zh: 視某月入可食之限，即為有食之月。

translations.literal: Inspect a given month entering edible limit, then that is the month having eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If a given month falls within the possible-eclipse zone, that month will have an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交周自五宮八度四十二分至六宮九度一十四分，又自十一宮二十度四十六分至初宮二十一度一十八分，皆可食之限。

translations.literal: Nodal longitude from fifth mansion 8°42′ to sixth mansion 9°14′, and from eleventh mansion 20°46′ to first mansion 21°18′, all are edible limits.
translations.idiomatic: The possible-eclipse zone runs from 8°42′ in the fifth mansion to 9°14′ in the sixth, and from 20°46′ in the eleventh mansion to 21°18′ in the first.

sentences.zh: 求平朔，

translations.literal: To find mean new moon,
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean new moon,

sentences.zh: 求實朔實時，並同月食求望法，惟不加望策。

translations.literal: To find true new moon true time, all same as lunar-eclipse method for full moon, only without adding full-moon interval.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true time of new moon, use the same method as for finding true full moon in the lunar-eclipse section, but without adding the half-month interval.

sentences.zh: 視本時月距正交入食限為有食。

translations.literal: Inspect this time moon's distance from true node entering eclipse limit as having eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If at that instant the moon's distance from the true node falls within the eclipse limit, an eclipse occurs.

sentences.zh: 自五宮十一度三十四分至六宮六度二十二分，又自十一宮二十三度三十八分至初宮十八度二十六分，為有食之限。

translations.literal: From fifth mansion 11°34′ to sixth mansion 6°22′, and from eleventh mansion 23°38′ to first mansion 18°26′, are limits for having eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At true new moon the eclipse limits run from 11°34′ in the fifth mansion to 6°22′ in the sixth, and from 23°38′ in the eleventh mansion to 18°26′ in the first.

sentences.zh: 求實朔用時，與月食求實望用時同。

translations.literal: To find true-new-moon apparent time, same as lunar-eclipse method for true-full-moon apparent time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent time of true new moon, use the same method as for the apparent time of true full moon in the lunar-eclipse section.

sentences.zh: 比視日出入，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Compare and view sun rise and set, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: The comparison with sunrise and sunset follows the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 求食甚用時，與月食求食甚時刻法同。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse apparent time, same as lunar-eclipse method for greatest-eclipse time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent time of greatest eclipse, use the same method as for the time of greatest eclipse in the lunar-eclipse section.

sentences.zh: 求太陽太陰實引，

translations.literal: To find sun and moon true anomaly,
translations.idiomatic: To find the true anomalies of the sun and moon,

sentences.zh: 求太陽太陰距地，並同月食。

translations.literal: To find sun and moon distance from Earth, all same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the geocentric distances of the sun and moon, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求地平高下差，先求本日太陰最大地半徑差，法同月食。

translations.literal: To find horizon altitude-parallax difference, first find this day's moon maximum diurnal parallax, method same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the horizon altitude-parallax difference, first compute the moon's maximum diurnal parallax for that day by the lunar-eclipse method.

sentences.zh: 乃減太陽最大地半徑差，得地平高下差。

translations.literal: Then subtract sun maximum diurnal parallax, obtaining horizon altitude-parallax difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the sun's maximum diurnal parallax to obtain the horizon altitude-parallax difference.

sentences.zh: 求太陽實半徑，先求太陽視半徑，法同月食。

translations.literal: To find sun true semidiameter, first find sun apparent semidiameter, method same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's true semidiameter, first compute its apparent semidiameter by the lunar-eclipse method.

sentences.zh: 內減太陽光分，得太陽實半徑。

translations.literal: Within subtract solar light-semidiameter, obtaining sun true semidiameter.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the solar limb from within to obtain the sun's true semidiameter.

sentences.zh: 求太陰視半徑，法同月食。

translations.literal: To find moon apparent semidiameter, method same as lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's apparent semidiameter, use the same method as for lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求食甚太陽黃道經度宿度，求經度與月食求太陰白道法同；

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse sun ecliptic longitude and lodge degree, to find longitude same as lunar-eclipse method for moon white path;
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's ecliptic longitude and lodge at greatest eclipse: the longitude is found by the same method as the moon's white-path longitude in the lunar-eclipse section;

sentences.zh: 求宿度同日躔。

translations.literal: To find lodge degree same as solar motion.
translations.idiomatic: the lodge position by the same method as in the solar-motion section.

sentences.zh: 求食甚太陰赤道經緯宿度，用黃赤大距，法同月食求太陰黃道。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse moon equatorial longitude, latitude, and lodge degree, use great ecliptic-equatorial distance, method same as lunar-eclipse method for moon ecliptic.
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's equatorial longitude, latitude, and lodge at greatest eclipse, use the great ecliptic-equatorial distance and the same method as for the moon's ecliptic in the lunar-eclipse section.

sentences.zh: 求黃赤及黃白、赤白二經交角，以食甚太陽距春、秋分黃道經度餘弦為一率，黃赤大距餘切為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率為餘切，檢表得黃赤二經交角。

translations.literal: To find ecliptic-equatorial and ecliptic-lunar and equatorial-lunar nodal angles: greatest-eclipse sun distance from spring-autumn equinox ecliptic longitude cosine as first ratio, great ecliptic-equatorial distance cotangent as second ratio, radius ten million as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained is cotangent, look up table for ecliptic-equatorial nodal angle.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic-equatorial, ecliptic-lunar, and equatorial-lunar nodal angles: use the cosine of the sun's ecliptic longitude from the equinox at greatest eclipse, the cotangent of the great ecliptic-equatorial distance, and the radius of ten million; look up the resulting cotangent in the tables to obtain the ecliptic-equatorial nodal angle.

sentences.zh: 冬至後黃經在赤經西，夏至後在赤經東，如太陽在二至，則無此角。

translations.literal: After winter solstice ecliptic longitude is west of equatorial longitude, after summer solstice east; if sun at the two solstices, then no this angle.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice the ecliptic longitude lies west of the equatorial longitude; after the summer solstice, east. If the sun is at either solstice, this angle does not exist.

sentences.zh: 又以前所得斜距黃道交角，即為黃白二經交角。

translations.literal: Further the previously obtained oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle is the ecliptic-lunar nodal angle.
translations.idiomatic: The oblique-separation ecliptic nodal angle obtained above is the ecliptic-lunar nodal angle.

sentences.zh: 實朔月距正交初宮、十一宮，白經在黃經西；

translations.literal: True-new-moon moon distance from true node at first and eleventh mansions, white-path longitude west of ecliptic longitude;
translations.idiomatic: At true new moon, if the moon is at the first or eleventh mansion from the true node, the white-path longitude lies west of the ecliptic longitude;

sentences.zh: 五宮、六宮，在黃經東。

translations.literal: Fifth and sixth mansions, east of ecliptic longitude.
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth or sixth mansion, it lies east of the ecliptic longitude.

sentences.zh: 二交角相加減，為赤白二經交角。

translations.literal: Two nodal angles add-subtract, as equatorial-lunar nodal angle.
translations.idiomatic: Combine the two nodal angles by addition or subtraction to obtain the equatorial-lunar nodal angle.

sentences.zh: 二交角同為東同為西者相加，白經在赤經之東西仍之。

translations.literal: Two nodal angles both east or both west then add, white-path longitude east-west of equatorial longitude remains.
translations.idiomatic: If both angles lie on the same side (both east or both west), add them; the white-path longitude remains on the same side of the equatorial longitude.

sentences.zh: 一為東一為西者相減。

translations.literal: One east one west then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If one is east and one west, subtract.

sentences.zh: 東西從大角。

translations.literal: East-west follows the larger angle.
translations.idiomatic: The east-west designation follows the larger angle.

sentences.zh: 如減盡，則無此角。

translations.literal: If subtracted completely, then no this angle.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction reduces the angle to zero, this angle does not exist.

sentences.zh: 如無黃赤二經交角，則黃白即赤白，東西並同。

translations.literal: If no ecliptic-equatorial nodal angle, then ecliptic-lunar is equatorial-lunar, east-west both same.
translations.idiomatic: If there is no ecliptic-equatorial nodal angle, the ecliptic-lunar angle is the equatorial-lunar angle, with the same east-west designation.

sentences.zh: 求用時太陽距午赤道度，以食甚用時與十二時相減，餘數變赤道度，得用時太陽距午赤道度。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time sun equatorial longitude from meridian: using greatest-eclipse apparent time subtract twelve hours, remainder converted to equatorial degrees, obtaining apparent-time sun equatorial longitude from meridian.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's equatorial longitude from the meridian at apparent time: subtract the greatest-eclipse apparent time from twelve hours, convert the remainder to equatorial degrees, and obtain the sun's equatorial longitude from the meridian.

sentences.zh: 求用時赤經高弧交角，用弧三角形，以北極距天頂為一邊，太陽距北極為一邊，赤緯在南，加九十度；

translations.literal: To find apparent-time right-ascension altitude arc angle, use spherical triangle, polar distance to zenith as one side, sun distance from north pole as one side, if declination south add ninety degrees;
translations.idiomatic: To find the right-ascension altitude arc angle at apparent time, by spherical triangle: use the polar distance to the zenith as one side and the sun's distance from the north pole as the other; if the declination is south, add ninety degrees;

sentences.zh: 在北，與九十度相減。

translations.literal: If north, subtract from ninety degrees.
translations.idiomatic: If north, subtract from ninety degrees.

sentences.zh: 用時太陽距午赤道度為所夾之角，求得對北極距天頂之角，為用時赤經高弧交角。

translations.literal: Apparent-time sun equatorial longitude from meridian as the enclosed angle, the angle opposite polar distance to zenith obtained, as apparent-time right-ascension altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: Use the sun's equatorial longitude from the meridian at apparent time as the included angle; the angle opposite the polar distance to the zenith is the right-ascension altitude arc angle at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 午前赤經在高弧東，午後赤經在高弧西。

translations.literal: Before noon right ascension is east of altitude arc, after noon right ascension is west of altitude arc.
translations.idiomatic: Before noon the right ascension lies east of the altitude arc; after noon, west.

sentences.zh: 若太陽在正午，則無此角。

translations.literal: If sun at noon, then no this angle.
translations.idiomatic: If the sun is at noon, this angle does not exist.

sentences.zh: 求用時太陽距天頂，以用時赤經高弧交角正弦為一率，北極距天頂之正弦為二率，用時太陽距午赤道度之正弦為三率，求得四率為正弦，檢表得太陽距天頂。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time sun distance from zenith: apparent-time right-ascension altitude arc angle sine as first ratio, polar distance to zenith sine as second ratio, apparent-time sun equatorial longitude from meridian sine as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained is sine, look up table for sun distance from zenith.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's zenith distance at apparent time: use the sine of the right-ascension altitude arc angle, the sine of the polar distance to the zenith, and the sine of the sun's equatorial longitude from the meridian; look up the resulting sine in the tables to obtain the sun's zenith distance.

sentences.zh: 求用時高下差，以半徑千萬為一率，地平高下差化秒為二率，用時太陽距天頂之正弦為三率，求得四率為秒，以分收之，為用時高下差。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time altitude-parallax difference: radius ten million as first ratio, horizon altitude-parallax difference converted to seconds as second ratio, apparent-time sun distance from zenith sine as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained is seconds, reduce to minutes, as apparent-time altitude-parallax difference.
translations.idiomatic: To find the altitude-parallax difference at apparent time: use the radius of ten million, the horizon altitude-parallax difference in seconds, and the sine of the sun's zenith distance; convert the result to minutes to obtain the altitude-parallax difference at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 求用時白經高弧交角，以用時赤經高弧交角與赤白二經交角相加減，得用時白經高弧交角。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time white-path altitude arc angle, apparent-time right-ascension altitude arc angle with equatorial-lunar nodal angle add-subtract, obtaining apparent-time white-path altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: To find the white-path altitude arc angle at apparent time, add or subtract the equatorial-lunar nodal angle from the right-ascension altitude arc angle.

sentences.zh: 東西同者相加，白經在高弧之東西仍之。

translations.literal: East-west same then add, white-path longitude east-west of altitude arc remains.
translations.idiomatic: If both lie on the same side, add; the white-path longitude remains on the same side of the altitude arc.

sentences.zh: 一東一西者相減，東西從大角。

translations.literal: One east one west then subtract, east-west follows the larger angle.
translations.idiomatic: If one is east and one west, subtract; the east-west designation follows the larger angle.

sentences.zh: 如無赤白二經交角，或無赤經高弧交角，則即以所有一角命之，東西並同。

translations.literal: If no equatorial-lunar nodal angle, or no right-ascension altitude arc angle, then directly use whichever angle exists, east-west both same.
translations.idiomatic: If either the equatorial-lunar nodal angle or the right-ascension altitude arc angle is absent, use whichever angle exists, with the same east-west designation.

sentences.zh: 如二角俱無，或同度減盡，則無此角。

translations.literal: If both angles absent, or same degree subtracted completely, then no this angle.
translations.idiomatic: If both angles are absent, or subtraction reduces them to zero, this angle does not exist.

sentences.zh: 食甚用時即真時。

translations.literal: Greatest-eclipse apparent time is true time.
translations.idiomatic: The apparent time of greatest eclipse is the true time.

sentences.zh: 用時高下差與食甚實緯，南加北減，即食甚兩心視相距。

translations.literal: Apparent-time altitude-parallax difference with greatest-eclipse true latitude, south add north subtract, is greatest-eclipse apparent center separation.
translations.idiomatic: Add the altitude-parallax difference at apparent time to the true latitude at greatest eclipse for south latitude and subtract for north; the result is the apparent center separation at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求用時對兩心視相距角，月在黃道北，取用時白經高弧交角；

translations.literal: To find apparent-time angle opposite apparent center separation: moon north of ecliptic, use apparent-time white-path altitude arc angle;
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent center separation at apparent time: if the moon is north of the ecliptic, use the white-path altitude arc angle at apparent time;

sentences.zh: 月在黃道南，取用時白經高弧交角之外角，實距在高弧之東西，月在北則與白經同，在南則相反。

translations.literal: Moon south of ecliptic, use exterior angle of apparent-time white-path altitude arc angle; true separation east-west of altitude arc, moon north then same as white path, south then opposite.
translations.idiomatic: if south of the ecliptic, use the exterior angle of the white-path altitude arc angle. For the east-west position of the true separation relative to the altitude arc: if the moon is north, it matches the white path; if south, it is reversed.

sentences.zh: 皆為用時對兩心視相距角。

translations.literal: All are apparent-time angle opposite apparent center separation.
translations.idiomatic: In each case this is the angle opposite the apparent center separation at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 若自經高弧交角過九十度，緯南如緯北，緯北如緯南。

translations.literal: If nodal altitude arc angle passes ninety degrees, south latitude as north latitude, north latitude as south latitude.
translations.idiomatic: If the nodal altitude arc angle exceeds ninety degrees, treat south latitude as north and north as south.

sentences.zh: 求用時對兩心實相距角，用平三角形，以食甚用時兩心實相距為一邊，即食甚實緯。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time angle opposite true center separation, use plane triangle, greatest-eclipse apparent-time true center separation as one side, namely greatest-eclipse true latitude.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the true center separation at apparent time, by plane triangle: use the true center separation at greatest-eclipse apparent time as one side—that is, the true latitude at greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 用時高下差為一邊，用時對兩心視相距角為所夾之角，即求得用時對兩心實相距角。

translations.literal: Apparent-time altitude-parallax difference as one side, apparent-time angle opposite apparent center separation as the enclosed angle, thus obtaining apparent-time angle opposite true center separation.
translations.idiomatic: Use the altitude-parallax difference at apparent time as the other side and the angle opposite the apparent center separation as the included angle; this yields the angle opposite the true center separation at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 求用時兩心視相距，以用時對兩心實相距角之正弦為一率，用時兩心實相距為二率，用時對兩心視相距角之正弦為三率，求得四率，即用時兩心視相距。

translations.literal: To find apparent-time apparent center separation: apparent-time angle opposite true center separation sine as first ratio, apparent-time true center separation as second ratio, apparent-time angle opposite apparent center separation sine as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained, is apparent-time apparent center separation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent center separation at apparent time: use the sine of the angle opposite the true center separation, the true center separation, and the sine of the angle opposite the apparent center separation; the fourth ratio is the apparent center separation at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 白經在高弧西，兩心視相距大於並徑者，或無食或未及等者，用時即初虧真時，在高弧東為已過及復圓真時。

translations.literal: White path west of altitude arc, apparent center separation greater than combined diameter, either no eclipse or not yet equal, apparent time is first-contact true time; east of altitude arc is past and last-contact true time.
translations.idiomatic: If the white path is west of the altitude arc and the apparent center separation exceeds the combined diameter—indicating no eclipse or not yet contact—the apparent time is the true time of first contact; if east of the altitude arc, it is past greatest eclipse or the true time of last contact.

sentences.zh: 若小於並徑，高弧西為初虧食甚之間，東為復圓食甚之間。

translations.literal: If less than combined diameter, west of altitude arc is between first contact and greatest eclipse, east is between last contact and greatest eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If less than the combined diameter, west of the altitude arc falls between first contact and greatest eclipse; east, between last contact and greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求食甚設時，用時白經高弧交角東向前取，西向後取，角大遠取，角小近取，遠不過九刻，近或數分。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse provisional time: apparent-time white-path altitude arc angle east take forward, west take backward; angle large take far, angle small take near; far not exceeding nine quarters, near perhaps several minutes.
translations.idiomatic: To find the provisional time of greatest eclipse: if the white-path altitude arc angle at apparent time is east, take a time forward; if west, backward. A large angle calls for a distant time, a small angle a near one—distant not beyond nine quarters of an hour, near perhaps only a few minutes.

sentences.zh: 量距用時前後若干分，為食甚設時。

translations.literal: Measure distance before and after apparent time by several minutes, as greatest-eclipse provisional time.
translations.idiomatic: Measure an interval of several minutes before or after the apparent time to obtain the provisional time of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求設時距分，以食甚設時與食甚用時相減，得設時距分。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time interval minutes: greatest-eclipse provisional time minus greatest-eclipse apparent time, obtaining provisional-time interval minutes.
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval in minutes from provisional to apparent time: subtract the greatest-eclipse apparent time from the provisional time.

sentences.zh: 求設時距弧，以一小時化秒為一率，一小時兩經斜距為二率，設時距分化秒為三率，求得四率，為設時距弧。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time interval arc: one hour in seconds as first ratio, one hour two-nodal oblique separation as second ratio, provisional-time interval minutes converted to seconds as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained, as provisional-time interval arc.
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval arc at provisional time: use one hour in seconds, the hourly two-nodal oblique separation, and the provisional interval in seconds; the fourth ratio is the interval arc.

sentences.zh: 求設時對距弧角，以食甚實緯為一率，設時距弧為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率為正切，檢表得設時對距弧角。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time angle opposite interval arc: greatest-eclipse true latitude as first ratio, provisional-time interval arc as second ratio, radius ten million as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained is tangent, look up table for provisional-time angle opposite interval arc.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the interval arc at provisional time: use the true latitude at greatest eclipse, the interval arc, and the radius of ten million; look up the resulting tangent in the tables.

sentences.zh: 求設時兩心實相距，以設時對距弧角之正弦為一率，設時距弧為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率，即設時兩心實相距。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time true center separation: provisional-time angle opposite interval arc sine as first ratio, provisional-time interval arc as second ratio, radius ten million as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained, is provisional-time true center separation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true center separation at provisional time: use the sine of the angle opposite the interval arc, the interval arc, and the radius of ten million; the fourth ratio is the true center separation.

sentences.zh: 求設時太陽距午赤道度，

translations.literal: To find provisional-time sun equatorial longitude from meridian,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's equatorial longitude from the meridian at provisional time,

sentences.zh: 求設時赤經高弧交角，

translations.literal: To find provisional-time right-ascension altitude arc angle,
translations.idiomatic: To find the right-ascension altitude arc angle at provisional time,

sentences.zh: 求設時太陽距天頂，

translations.literal: To find provisional-time sun distance from zenith,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's zenith distance at provisional time,

sentences.zh: 求設時高下差，

translations.literal: To find provisional-time altitude-parallax difference,
translations.idiomatic: To find the altitude-parallax difference at provisional time,

sentences.zh: 求設時白經高弧交角，以上五條，皆與用時同，但皆用設時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time white-path altitude arc angle; the above five items all same as apparent time, but all use provisional-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the white-path altitude arc angle at provisional time—the above five steps all follow the apparent-time method, but each is computed separately using provisional-time values.

sentences.zh: 求設時對兩心視相距角，月在黃道北，以設時白經高弧交角與設時對距弧角相減，月在黃道南則相加，又與半周相減，餘為設時對兩心視相距角。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time angle opposite apparent center separation: moon north of ecliptic, subtract provisional-time white-path altitude arc angle and provisional-time angle opposite interval arc; moon south of ecliptic then add, further subtract from semicircle, remainder as provisional-time angle opposite apparent center separation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent center separation at provisional time: if the moon is north of the ecliptic, subtract the angle opposite the interval arc from the white-path altitude arc angle; if south, add them, then subtract from a semicircle; the remainder is the angle opposite the apparent center separation.

sentences.zh: 相減者，對距弧角小，實距在高弧之東西與白經同；

translations.literal: When subtracting, if angle opposite interval arc small, true separation east-west of altitude arc same as white path;
translations.idiomatic: When subtracting: if the angle opposite the interval arc is small, the east-west position of the true separation relative to the altitude arc matches the white path;

sentences.zh: 對距弧角大則相反。

translations.literal: If angle opposite interval arc large then opposite.
translations.idiomatic: If large, it is reversed.

sentences.zh: 相加又減半周者，實距在高弧之東西，恆與白經反。

translations.literal: When adding and further subtracting semicircle, true separation east-west of altitude arc always opposite to white path.
translations.idiomatic: When adding and then subtracting a semicircle, the east-west position of the true separation is always opposite to the white path.

sentences.zh: 如兩角相等而減盡無餘，或相加適足一百八十度，則無交角，亦無對設時兩心實相距角，即以設時高下差與設時兩心實相距相減，餘為設時兩心視相距。

translations.literal: If two angles equal and subtraction leaves no remainder, or addition exactly fills one hundred eighty degrees, then no nodal angle, also no angle opposite provisional-time true center separation; then subtract provisional-time altitude-parallax difference from provisional-time true center separation, remainder as provisional-time apparent center separation.
translations.idiomatic: If the two angles are equal and subtraction leaves no remainder, or their sum exactly equals 180°, there is no nodal angle and no angle opposite the true center separation at provisional time; subtract the altitude-parallax difference from the true center separation to obtain the apparent center separation.

sentences.zh: 若白經高弧交角過九十度，緯南如緯北，緯北如緯南。

translations.literal: If white-path altitude arc angle passes ninety degrees, south latitude as north latitude, north latitude as south latitude.
translations.idiomatic: If the white-path altitude arc angle exceeds ninety degrees, treat south latitude as north and north as south.

sentences.zh: 求設時對兩心實相距角，

translations.literal: To find provisional-time angle opposite true center separation,
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the true center separation at provisional time,

sentences.zh: 求設時兩心視相距，皆與用時同。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time apparent center separation, all same as apparent time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent center separation at provisional time, use the same method as at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 求設時白經高弧交角較，以設時白經高弧交角與用時白經高弧交角相減，即得。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time white-path altitude arc angle difference: provisional-time white-path altitude arc angle minus apparent-time white-path altitude arc angle, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the difference in white-path altitude arc angles: subtract the apparent-time angle from the provisional-time angle.

sentences.zh: 求設時高弧交用時視距角，以設時白經高弧交角較與用時對兩心實相距角相加減，即得。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time altitude-arc with apparent-time apparent-separation angle: provisional-time white-path altitude arc angle difference with apparent-time angle opposite true center separation add-subtract, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle between the altitude arc at provisional time and the apparent separation at apparent time: add or subtract the white-path altitude arc angle difference from the angle opposite the true center separation at apparent time.

sentences.zh: 緯北為減，緯南為加。

translations.literal: North latitude subtract, south latitude add.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract for north latitude, add for south.

sentences.zh: 若白經高弧交角過九十度，反是。

translations.literal: If white-path altitude arc angle passes ninety degrees, reversed.
translations.idiomatic: If the white-path altitude arc angle exceeds ninety degrees, reverse the addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 求對設時視行角，以設時高弧交用時視距角與設時對兩心實相距角相加減，即得。

translations.literal: To find angle opposite provisional-time apparent motion: provisional-time altitude-arc with apparent-time apparent-separation angle with provisional-time angle opposite true center separation add-subtract, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent motion at provisional time: add or subtract the provisional-time angle opposite the true center separation from the angle between the altitude arc and the apparent separation.

sentences.zh: 兩實距同在高弧東，或同在西，則減；

translations.literal: Both true separations both east of altitude arc, or both west, then subtract;
translations.idiomatic: If both true separations lie on the same side of the altitude arc (both east or both west), subtract;

sentences.zh: 一東一西者，則加；

translations.literal: One east one west, then add;
translations.idiomatic: If one is east and one west, add;

sentences.zh: 加過半周者，與全周相減，用其餘。

translations.literal: If addition passes semicircle, subtract from full circle, use the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: If the sum exceeds a semicircle, subtract from the full circle and use the remainder.

sentences.zh: 如無設時對兩心實相距角，設時高下差大於設時兩心實相距，則設時高弧交用時視距角即對設時視行角；

translations.literal: If no provisional-time angle opposite true center separation, if provisional-time altitude-parallax difference greater than provisional-time true center separation, then provisional-time altitude-arc with apparent-time apparent-separation angle is angle opposite provisional-time apparent motion;
translations.idiomatic: If there is no angle opposite the true center separation at provisional time: when the altitude-parallax difference at provisional time exceeds the true center separation at provisional time, the angle between the altitude arc at provisional time and the apparent separation at apparent time is the angle opposite the apparent motion at provisional time;

sentences.zh: 設時高下差小於設時兩心實相距，則以設時高弧交用時視距角與半周相減，餘為對設時視行角。

translations.literal: If provisional-time altitude-parallax difference less than provisional-time true center separation, then subtract provisional-time altitude-arc with apparent-time apparent-separation angle from semicircle, remainder as angle opposite provisional-time apparent motion.
translations.idiomatic: When the altitude-parallax difference is less than the true center separation, subtract the angle between the altitude arc and the apparent separation from a semicircle; the remainder is the angle opposite the apparent motion at provisional time.

sentences.zh: 求對設時視距角，用平三角形，以用時兩心視相距為一邊，設時兩心視相距為一邊，對設時視行角為所夾之角，即求得對設時視距角。

translations.literal: To find angle opposite provisional-time apparent separation, use plane triangle, apparent-time apparent center separation as one side, provisional-time apparent center separation as one side, angle opposite provisional-time apparent motion as the enclosed angle, thus obtaining angle opposite provisional-time apparent separation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent separation at provisional time, by plane triangle: use the apparent center separation at apparent time as one side, the apparent center separation at provisional time as the other, and the angle opposite the apparent motion at provisional time as the included angle; this yields the angle opposite the apparent separation at provisional time.

sentences.zh: 求設時視行，以對設時視距角之正弦為一率，設時兩心視相距為二率，對設時視行角正弦為三率，求得四率，為設時視行。

translations.literal: To find provisional-time apparent motion: sine of angle opposite provisional-time apparent separation as first ratio, provisional-time apparent center separation as second ratio, sine of angle opposite provisional-time apparent motion as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained, as provisional-time apparent motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent motion at provisional time: use the sine of the angle opposite the apparent separation, the apparent center separation at provisional time, and the sine of the angle opposite the apparent motion; the fourth ratio is the apparent motion at provisional time.

sentences.zh: 求真時視行，以半徑千萬為一率，對設時視距角餘弦為二率，用時兩心視相距為三率，求得四率，為真時視行。

translations.literal: To find true-time apparent motion: radius ten million as first ratio, cosine of angle opposite provisional-time apparent separation as second ratio, apparent-time apparent center separation as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained, as true-time apparent motion.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent motion at true time: use the radius of ten million, the cosine of the angle opposite the apparent separation at provisional time, and the apparent center separation at apparent time; the fourth ratio is the apparent motion at true time.

sentences.zh: 求真時兩心視相距。

translations.literal: To find true-time apparent center separation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent center separation at true time.

sentences.zh: 以半徑千萬為一率，對設時視距角正弦為二率，用時兩心視相距為三率，求得四率，為真時兩心視相距。

translations.literal: Radius ten million as first ratio, sine of angle opposite provisional-time apparent separation as second ratio, apparent-time apparent center separation as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained, as true-time apparent center separation.
translations.idiomatic: Use the radius of ten million, the sine of the angle opposite the apparent separation at provisional time, and the apparent center separation at apparent time; the fourth ratio is the apparent center separation at true time.

sentences.zh: 求食甚真時，以設時視行為一率，設時距分為二率，真時視行為三率，求得四率，為真時距分，以加減食甚用時，白經在高弧西則加，在高弧東則減。

translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse true time: provisional-time apparent motion as first ratio, provisional-time interval minutes as second ratio, true-time apparent motion as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained as true-time interval minutes, add or subtract from greatest-eclipse apparent time; white path west of altitude arc then add, east then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true time of greatest eclipse: use the apparent motion at provisional time, the provisional-time interval in minutes, and the apparent motion at true time; the fourth ratio gives the true-time interval in minutes. Add or subtract this from the apparent time of greatest eclipse—add if the white path is west of the altitude arc, subtract if east.

sentences.zh: 得食甚真時。

translations.literal: Greatest-eclipse true time obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the true time of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求真時距弧，

translations.literal: To find true-time interval arc,
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval arc at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時對距弧角，

translations.literal: To find true-time angle opposite interval arc,
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the interval arc at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時兩心實相距，以上三條，法與設時同，但皆用真時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find true-time true center separation; the above three items, method same as provisional time, but all use true-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true center separation at true time—the above three steps follow the provisional-time method, but all computations use true-time degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求真時太陽距午赤道度，

translations.literal: To find true-time sun equatorial longitude from meridian,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's equatorial longitude from the meridian at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時赤經高弧交角，

translations.literal: To find true-time right-ascension altitude arc angle,
translations.idiomatic: To find the right-ascension altitude arc angle at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時太陽距天頂，

translations.literal: To find true-time sun distance from zenith,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's zenith distance at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時高下差，

translations.literal: To find true-time altitude-parallax difference,
translations.idiomatic: To find the altitude-parallax difference at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時白經高弧交角，

translations.literal: To find true-time white-path altitude arc angle,
translations.idiomatic: To find the white-path altitude arc angle at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時對兩心視相距角，

translations.literal: To find true-time angle opposite apparent center separation,
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent center separation at true time,

sentences.zh: 求真時對兩心實相距角，

translations.literal: To find true-time angle opposite true center separation,
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the true center separation at true time,

sentences.zh: 求考真時兩心視相距，以上八條，法與用時同，但皆用真時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find verified-true-time apparent center separation; the above eight items, method same as apparent time, but all use true-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent center separation at verified true time—the above eight steps follow the apparent-time method, but all computations use true-time degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求真時白經高弧交角較，法同設時，但用真時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find true-time white-path altitude arc angle difference, method same as provisional time, but use true-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the difference in white-path altitude arc angles at true time, use the same method as at provisional time, but compute with true-time degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求真時高弧交設時視距角，法同設時，加減有異。

translations.literal: To find true-time altitude-arc with provisional-time apparent-separation angle, method same as provisional time, add-subtract differs.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle between the altitude arc at true time and the apparent separation at provisional time: the method matches provisional time, but the addition and subtraction differ.

sentences.zh: 月在黃道北，設時真時兩實距在高弧東西同，惟白經異。

translations.literal: Moon north of ecliptic, provisional-time and true-time two true separations east-west of altitude arc same, only white path differs.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is north of the ecliptic and the two true separations at provisional and true time lie on the same side of the altitude arc, only the white-path positions differ.

sentences.zh: 設時白經高弧交角小則加，大則減。

translations.literal: If provisional-time white-path altitude arc angle small then add, large then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the white-path altitude arc angle at provisional time is small, add; if large, subtract.

sentences.zh: 若白經亦同，反是。

translations.literal: If white path also same, reversed.
translations.idiomatic: If the white-path positions also match, reverse the addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 若兩實距一東一西，則皆相減。

translations.literal: If two true separations one east one west, then both subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the two true separations lie on opposite sides (one east, one west), subtract in both cases.

sentences.zh: 月在黃道南，設時交角小則加，大則減。

translations.literal: Moon south of ecliptic, provisional-time nodal angle small then add, large then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is south of the ecliptic, add when the nodal angle at provisional time is small and subtract when it is large.

sentences.zh: 如無設時對兩心實相距角，設時高下差大於設時兩心實相距，則真時白經高弧交角較，即真時高弧交設時視距角；

translations.literal: If no provisional-time angle opposite true center separation, if provisional-time altitude-parallax difference greater than provisional-time true center separation, then true-time white-path altitude arc angle difference is true-time altitude-arc with provisional-time apparent-separation angle;
translations.idiomatic: If there is no angle opposite the true center separation at provisional time: when the altitude-parallax difference at provisional time exceeds the true center separation at provisional time, the white-path altitude arc angle difference at true time equals the angle between the altitude arc at true time and the apparent separation at provisional time;

sentences.zh: 設時高下差小於設時兩心實相距，則以真時白經高弧交角較與半周相減，餘為真時高弧交設時視距角。

translations.literal: If provisional-time altitude-parallax difference less than provisional-time true center separation, then subtract true-time white-path altitude arc angle difference from semicircle, remainder as true-time altitude-arc with provisional-time apparent-separation angle.
translations.idiomatic: when the altitude-parallax difference is less than the true center separation, subtract the white-path altitude arc angle difference at true time from a semicircle; the remainder is the angle between the altitude arc at true time and the apparent separation at provisional time.

sentences.zh: 若白經高弧交角過九十度，緯南如緯北，緯北如緯南。

translations.literal: If white-path altitude arc angle passes ninety degrees, south latitude as north latitude, north latitude as south latitude.
translations.idiomatic: If the white-path altitude arc angle exceeds ninety degrees, treat south latitude as north and north as south.

sentences.zh: 求對考真時視行角，法同設時。

translations.literal: To find angle opposite verified-true-time apparent motion, method same as provisional time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent motion at verified true time, use the same method as at provisional time.

sentences.zh: 如設時實距與高弧合，無東西者，設時高下差大於設時兩心實相距，則相減，小則加。

translations.literal: If at provisional time true separation coincides with altitude arc, no east-west, if provisional-time altitude-parallax difference greater than provisional-time true center separation then subtract, if smaller then add.
translations.idiomatic: If at provisional time the true separation coincides with the altitude arc with no east-west distinction: subtract when the altitude-parallax difference exceeds the true center separation, add when it is smaller.

sentences.zh: 如真時白經高弧交角較與設時對兩心實相距角相等，而減盡無餘，則真時對兩心實相距角，即對考真時視行角。

translations.literal: If true-time white-path altitude arc angle difference equals provisional-time angle opposite true center separation and subtraction leaves no remainder, then true-time angle opposite true center separation is angle opposite verified-true-time apparent motion.
translations.idiomatic: If the white-path altitude arc angle difference at true time equals the angle opposite the true center separation at provisional time and subtraction leaves no remainder, the angle opposite the true center separation at true time is the angle opposite the apparent motion at verified true time.

sentences.zh: 或相加適足半周，則真時對兩心實相距角與半周相減，即對考真時視行角。

translations.literal: Or if addition exactly fills semicircle, then subtract true-time angle opposite true center separation from semicircle, that is angle opposite verified-true-time apparent motion.
translations.idiomatic: Or if the sum exactly equals a semicircle, subtract the angle opposite the true center separation at true time from a semicircle; the result is the angle opposite the apparent motion at verified true time.

sentences.zh: 求對考真時視距角，

translations.literal: To find angle opposite verified-true-time apparent separation,
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent separation at verified true time,

sentences.zh: 求考真時視行，以上二條，法同設時，但用考真時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find verified-true-time apparent motion; the above two items, method same as provisional time, but use verified-true-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent motion at verified true time—the above two steps follow the provisional-time method, but compute with verified-true-time degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求定真時視行，如定真時視行與考真時視行等，則食甚真時即為定真時。

translations.literal: To find fixed-true-time apparent motion, if fixed-true-time apparent motion equals verified-true-time apparent motion, then greatest-eclipse true time is fixed true time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent motion at fixed true time: if the fixed-true-time apparent motion equals the verified-true-time apparent motion, the true time of greatest eclipse is the fixed true time.

sentences.zh: 如或大或小，再用下法求之。

translations.literal: If greater or smaller, apply the method below again.
translations.idiomatic: If it is greater or smaller, apply the method below again.

sentences.zh: 求定真時兩心視相距，以上二條，法同真時，用考真時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find fixed-true-time apparent center separation; the above two items, method same as true time, use verified-true-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent center separation at fixed true time—the above two steps follow the true-time method, using verified-true-time degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求食甚定真時，以考真時視行為一率，設時距分與真時距分相減餘為二率，定真時視行為三率，求得四率，為定真時距分。
