translations.literal: To find greatest-eclipse fixed true time: verified-true-time apparent motion as first ratio, provisional-time interval minutes minus true-time interval minutes remainder as second ratio, fixed-true-time apparent motion as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained as fixed-true-time interval minutes.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed true time of greatest eclipse: use the apparent motion at verified true time as the first ratio, the difference between the provisional-time and true-time interval minutes as the second ratio, and the apparent motion at fixed true time as the third ratio; the fourth ratio gives the fixed-true-time interval in minutes.

sentences.zh: 以加減食甚設時，白經在高弧東，設時距分小測減，大則加。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from greatest-eclipse provisional time, white path east of altitude arc, if provisional-time interval minutes small then subtract, if large then add.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this from the provisional time of greatest eclipse: if the white path is east of the altitude arc, subtract when the provisional-time interval is small and add when it is large.

sentences.zh: 白經在高弧西，反是。

translations.literal: White path west of altitude arc, reversed.
translations.idiomatic: If the white path is west of the altitude arc, reverse the addition and subtraction.

sentences.zh: 得食甚定真時。

translations.literal: Greatest-eclipse fixed true time obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the fixed true time of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求食分，以太陽實半徑倍之為一率，十分為二率，並徑內減定真時兩心視相距餘為三率，求得四率，即食分。

translations.literal: To find eclipse magnitude: double solar true semidiameter as first ratio, ten as second ratio, within combined diameter subtract remainder of fixed-true-time apparent center separation as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained, namely eclipse magnitude.
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse magnitude: use twice the solar true semidiameter as the first ratio and ten as the second; subtract the apparent center separation at fixed true time from the combined diameter as the third ratio; the fourth ratio is the eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓前設時，白經在高弧西，食甚用時兩心視相距與並徑相去不遠，即以食甚用時為初虧前設時，小則向前取，大則向後取，量距食甚用時前後若干分，為初虧前設時。

translations.literal: To find first/last contact before provisional time, white path west of altitude arc, if greatest-eclipse apparent-time apparent center separation and combined diameter not far apart, then use greatest-eclipse apparent time as first-contact before provisional time; if smaller take forward, if larger take backward, measure before and after greatest-eclipse apparent time by several minutes, as first-contact before provisional time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the provisional time before first or last contact: if the white path is west of the altitude arc and the apparent center separation at greatest-eclipse apparent time is close to the combined diameter, use the apparent time of greatest eclipse as the provisional time before first contact; if smaller, take a time before; if larger, take a time after—measure several minutes before or after the apparent time of greatest eclipse to obtain the provisional time before first contact.

sentences.zh: 與食甚定真時相減，餘數與食甚定真時相加，為復圓前設時，白經在高弧東，先取復圓，後得初虧，理並同。

translations.literal: Subtract from greatest-eclipse fixed true time, remainder added to greatest-eclipse fixed true time, as last-contact before provisional time; white path east of altitude arc, take last contact first then obtain first contact, reasoning same.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the fixed true time of greatest eclipse and add the remainder to the fixed true time of greatest eclipse to obtain the provisional time before last contact. If the white path is east of the altitude arc, take last contact first and then first contact—the reasoning is the same.

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時距分，

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time interval minutes,
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval minutes at the provisional time before first contact,

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時距弧，

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time interval arc,
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval arc at the provisional time before first contact,

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時對距弧角，初虧前設時在食甚用時前為西，在食甚用時後為東。

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time angle opposite interval arc: if first-contact before provisional time is before greatest-eclipse apparent time it is west, if after greatest-eclipse apparent time it is east.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the interval arc at the provisional time before first contact: if that provisional time precedes the apparent time of greatest eclipse, it is west; if it follows, it is east.

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時兩心實相距，以上四條，法同食甚設時，但用初虧前設時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time true center separation; the above four items, method same as greatest-eclipse provisional time, but use first-contact before provisional-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the true center separation at the provisional time before first contact—the above four steps follow the greatest-eclipse provisional-time method, but compute with degrees at the provisional time before first contact.

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時太陽距午赤道度，

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time sun equatorial longitude from meridian,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's equatorial longitude from the meridian at the provisional time before first contact,

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時赤經高弧交角，

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time right-ascension altitude arc angle,
translations.idiomatic: To find the right-ascension altitude arc angle at the provisional time before first contact,

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時太陽距天頂，

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time sun distance from zenith,
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's zenith distance at the provisional time before first contact,

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時高下差，

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time altitude-parallax difference,
translations.idiomatic: To find the altitude-parallax difference at the provisional time before first contact,

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時白經高弧交角，以上五條，法同食甚用時。

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time white-path altitude arc angle; the above five items, method same as greatest-eclipse apparent time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the white-path altitude arc angle at the provisional time before first contact—the above five steps follow the greatest-eclipse apparent-time method.

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時對兩心視相距角，法同食甚用時，加減有異，月在黃道北，二角東西同，則相加；

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time angle opposite apparent center separation, method same as greatest-eclipse apparent time, add-subtract differs; moon north of ecliptic, if two angles east-west same then add;
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent center separation at the provisional time before first contact: the method matches greatest-eclipse apparent time, but addition and subtraction differ. If the moon is north of the ecliptic and both angles lie on the same side, add;

sentences.zh: 一東一西，相減。

translations.literal: One east one west, subtract.
translations.idiomatic: if one is east and one west, subtract.

sentences.zh: 月在黃道南，反是。

translations.literal: Moon south of ecliptic, reversed.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is south of the ecliptic, reverse the rule.

sentences.zh: 又與半周相減。

translations.literal: Further subtract from semicircle.
translations.idiomatic: Then subtract from a semicircle.

sentences.zh: 若白經高弧交角過九十度，則緯南、緯北互異。

translations.literal: If white-path altitude arc angle passes ninety degrees, then south latitude and north latitude interchange.
translations.idiomatic: If the white-path altitude arc angle exceeds ninety degrees, interchange south and north latitude.

sentences.zh: 餘同食甚設時。

translations.literal: Remainder same as greatest-eclipse provisional time.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining steps follow the greatest-eclipse provisional-time method.

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時對兩心實相距角，

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time angle opposite true center separation,
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the true center separation at the provisional time before first contact,

sentences.zh: 求初虧前設時兩心視相距，以上二條，法同食甚用時，但用初虧前設時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find first-contact before provisional-time apparent center separation; the above two items, method same as greatest-eclipse apparent time, but use first-contact before provisional-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent center separation at the provisional time before first contact—the above two steps follow the greatest-eclipse apparent-time method, but compute with degrees at the provisional time before first contact.

sentences.zh: 求初虧後設時，視初虧前設時兩心視相距小於並徑，則向前取，大則向後取，察其較之多寡，量取前後若干分，為初虧後設時。

translations.literal: To find first-contact after provisional time: if first-contact before provisional-time apparent center separation less than combined diameter then take forward, if greater then take backward, observe how much the difference varies, measure before and after by several minutes, as first-contact after provisional time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the provisional time after first contact: if the apparent center separation at the provisional time before first contact is less than the combined diameter, take a time before; if greater, take a time after. Observe the magnitude of the difference and measure several minutes before or after to obtain the provisional time after first contact.

sentences.zh: 以下逐條推算，皆與前設時同，但用後設時度分立算。

translations.literal: Below, compute each step in sequence, all same as before provisional time, but use after provisional-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: For each step below, follow the before-provisional-time method, but compute with degrees at the after-provisional time.

sentences.zh: 求初虧視距較，以前後設時兩心視相距相減，即得。

translations.literal: To find first-contact apparent-separation difference: subtract before and after provisional-time apparent center separations, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the first-contact apparent-separation difference: subtract the apparent center separations at the before- and after-provisional times.

sentences.zh: 求初虧設時較，以前後設時距分相減，即得。

translations.literal: To find first-contact provisional-time difference: subtract before and after provisional-time interval minutes, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the first-contact provisional-time difference: subtract the interval minutes at the before- and after-provisional times.

sentences.zh: 求初虧視距並徑較，以初虧後設時兩心視相距與並徑相減，即得。

translations.literal: To find first-contact apparent-separation combined-diameter difference: subtract combined diameter from first-contact after provisional-time apparent center separation, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the first-contact apparent-separation combined-diameter difference: subtract the combined diameter from the apparent center separation at the provisional time after first contact.

sentences.zh: 求初虧定真時，以初虧視距較為一率，初虧設時較為二率，初虧視距並徑較為三率，求得四率，為初虧真時距分。

translations.literal: To find first-contact fixed true time: first-contact apparent-separation difference as first ratio, first-contact provisional-time difference as second ratio, first-contact apparent-separation combined-diameter difference as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained as first-contact true-time interval minutes.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed true time of first contact: use the apparent-separation difference, the provisional-time difference, and the apparent-separation combined-diameter difference as ratios; the fourth ratio gives the true-time interval minutes for first contact.

sentences.zh: 以加減初虧後設時，後設時兩心視相距大於並徑為加，小為減。

translations.literal: Add or subtract from first-contact after provisional time: if after provisional-time apparent center separation greater than combined diameter then add, if smaller then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this from the provisional time after first contact: add if the apparent center separation at the after-provisional time exceeds the combined diameter, subtract if it is smaller.

sentences.zh: 得初虧真時。

translations.literal: First-contact true time obtained.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the true time of first contact.

sentences.zh: 乃以初虧真時依前法求其兩心視相距，果與並徑等，則初虧真時即初虧定真時。

translations.literal: Then at first-contact true time follow previous method to find its apparent center separation; if it indeed equals combined diameter, then first-contact true time is first-contact fixed true time.
translations.idiomatic: Then, at the true time of first contact, compute the apparent center separation by the previous method; if it equals the combined diameter, the true time of first contact is the fixed true time of first contact.

sentences.zh: 初虧真時對兩心實相距角即初虧方位角。

translations.literal: Angle opposite true center separation at first-contact true time is first-contact orientation angle.
translations.idiomatic: The angle opposite the true center separation at the true time of first contact is the orientation angle at first contact.

sentences.zh: 如或大或小，則以初虧前後設時兩心視相距與並徑尤近者，與考真時兩心視相距相較，依法比例，得初虧定真時。

translations.literal: If greater or smaller, then compare whichever of before and after provisional-time apparent center separations is closest to combined diameter with verified-true-time apparent center separation, by proportional method obtain first-contact fixed true time.
translations.idiomatic: If it is too large or too small, compare whichever of the before- and after-provisional-time apparent center separations is nearest the combined diameter with the apparent center separation at verified true time, and by proportion obtain the fixed true time of first contact.

sentences.zh: 求復圓前設時諸條，法同初虧，但用復圓前設時度分立算。

translations.literal: To find last-contact before provisional time for all items, method same as first contact, but use last-contact before provisional-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find all quantities at the provisional time before last contact, use the first-contact method, but compute with degrees at the provisional time before last contact.

sentences.zh: 求復圓後設時，視復圓前設時兩心視相距小於並徑，則向後取，大於並徑，則向前取，察其較之多寡，量取前後若干分，為復圓後設時。

translations.literal: To find last-contact after provisional time: if last-contact before provisional-time apparent center separation less than combined diameter then take backward, if greater than combined diameter then take forward, observe how much the difference varies, measure before and after by several minutes, as last-contact after provisional time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the provisional time after last contact: if the apparent center separation at the provisional time before last contact is less than the combined diameter, take a time after; if greater than the combined diameter, take a time before. Observe the magnitude of the difference and measure several minutes before or after to obtain the provisional time after last contact.

sentences.zh: 逐條推算，皆與前設時同，但用後設時度分立算。

translations.literal: Compute each step in sequence, all same as before provisional time, but use after provisional-time degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: Compute each step in sequence by the before-provisional-time method, but use degrees at the after-provisional time.

sentences.zh: 求復圓視距較，

translations.literal: To find last-contact apparent-separation difference,
translations.idiomatic: To find the last-contact apparent-separation difference,

sentences.zh: 求復圓設時較，

translations.literal: To find last-contact provisional-time difference,
translations.idiomatic: To find the last-contact provisional-time difference,

sentences.zh: 求復圓視距並徑較，

translations.literal: To find last-contact apparent-separation combined-diameter difference,
translations.idiomatic: To find the last-contact apparent-separation combined-diameter difference,

sentences.zh: 求復圓定真時，以上四條，皆與初虧法同，但用復圓度分立算。

translations.literal: To find last-contact fixed true time; the above four items, all same as first-contact method, but use last-contact degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed true time of last contact—the above four steps all follow the first-contact method, but compute with last-contact degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求食限總時，置初虧定真時，減復圓定真時，即得。

translations.literal: To find total eclipse duration: set first-contact fixed true time, subtract last-contact fixed true time, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the total duration of the eclipse: subtract the fixed true time of last contact from the fixed true time of first contact.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓定交角，初虧白經在高弧之東，以初虧方位角與半周相減，在高弧之西，即用初虧方位角；

translations.literal: To find first/last contact fixed contact angle: if first-contact white path east of altitude arc, subtract first-contact orientation angle from semicircle; if west of altitude arc, use first-contact orientation angle directly;
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed contact angles at first and last contact: if the white path at first contact is east of the altitude arc, subtract the orientation angle at first contact from a semicircle; if west, use the orientation angle at first contact directly;

sentences.zh: 復圓反是：皆為定交角。

translations.literal: Last contact reversed: all are fixed contact angles.
translations.idiomatic: for last contact, reverse the rule. Each result is a fixed contact angle.

sentences.zh: 求初虧、復圓方位，法與甲子元同，但以定交角初度初虧白經在高弧東為正上，在西為正下；

translations.literal: To find first/last contact orientation, method same as jiazi epoch, but at the initial degree of fixed contact angle, if first-contact white path east of altitude arc it is directly above, if west directly below;
translations.idiomatic: To find the orientation at first and last contact, use the jiazi epoch method, but at the initial degree of the fixed contact angle: if the white path at first contact is east of the altitude arc, the orientation is directly above; if west, directly below;

sentences.zh: 復圓在東為正下，在西為正上。

translations.literal: Last contact east is directly below, west is directly above.
translations.idiomatic: at last contact, east is directly below and west is directly above.

sentences.zh: 求帶食用日出入分，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse sun rise and set times, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sunrise and sunset times for a horizon eclipse, use the same method as in the jiazi epoch system.

sentences.zh: 求帶食距時，以日出入分與食甚用時相減，即得。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse interval time: subtract sun rise/set time from greatest-eclipse apparent time, thus obtained.
translations.idiomatic: To find the interval time to the horizon: subtract the sunrise or sunset time from the apparent time of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求帶食距弧，法同食甚設時，但用帶食距時立算。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse interval arc, method same as greatest-eclipse provisional time, but use horizon-eclipse interval time to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the horizon interval arc, use the greatest-eclipse provisional-time method, but compute from the horizon interval time.

sentences.zh: 求帶食赤經高弧交角，以黃赤距緯之餘弦為一率，北極高度之正弦為二率，半徑千萬為三率，求得四率為餘弦，檢表得帶食赤經高弧交角。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse right-ascension altitude arc angle: cosine of ecliptic-equatorial latitude distance as first ratio, sine of polar altitude as second ratio, radius ten million as third ratio, fourth ratio obtained is cosine, look up table for horizon-eclipse right-ascension altitude arc angle.
translations.idiomatic: To find the right-ascension altitude arc angle at the horizon: use the cosine of the ecliptic-equatorial latitude distance, the sine of the polar altitude, and the radius of ten million; look up the resulting cosine in the tables to obtain the right-ascension altitude arc angle at the horizon.

sentences.zh: 求帶食白經高弧交角，法與食甚用時同，但用帶食度分立算。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse white-path altitude arc angle, method same as greatest-eclipse apparent time, but use horizon-eclipse degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the white-path altitude arc angle at the horizon, use the greatest-eclipse apparent-time method, but compute with horizon-eclipse degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求帶食對距弧角，

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse angle opposite interval arc,
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the interval arc at the horizon,

sentences.zh: 求帶食兩心實相距，

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse true center separation,
translations.idiomatic: To find the true center separation at the horizon,

sentences.zh: 求帶食對兩心視相距角，以上三條，法與食甚設時同，但用帶食度分立算。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse angle opposite apparent center separation; the above three items, method same as greatest-eclipse provisional time, but use horizon-eclipse degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the apparent center separation at the horizon—the above three steps follow the greatest-eclipse provisional-time method, but compute with horizon-eclipse degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求帶食對兩心實相距角，用地平高下差，餘法同食甚用時。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse angle opposite true center separation, use horizon altitude-parallax difference, remaining method same as greatest-eclipse apparent time.
translations.idiomatic: To find the angle opposite the true center separation at the horizon, use the horizon altitude-parallax difference; the remaining steps follow the greatest-eclipse apparent-time method.

sentences.zh: 求帶食兩心視相距，法同食甚用時，但用帶食度分立算。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse apparent center separation, method same as greatest-eclipse apparent time, but use horizon-eclipse degrees separately to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the apparent center separation at the horizon, use the greatest-eclipse apparent-time method, but compute with horizon-eclipse degrees separately.

sentences.zh: 求帶食分秒，與求食分同，用帶食相距立算。

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse magnitude, same as finding eclipse magnitude, use horizon-eclipse separation to compute.
translations.idiomatic: To find the magnitude of the horizon eclipse, use the same method as for eclipse magnitude, computing from the separation at the horizon.

sentences.zh: 求帶食方位，在食甚前者，用初虧法；

translations.literal: To find horizon-eclipse orientation, if before greatest eclipse, use first-contact method;
translations.idiomatic: To find the orientation of a horizon eclipse: if the event occurs before greatest eclipse, use the first-contact method;

sentences.zh: 在食甚後者，用復圓法。

translations.literal: If after greatest eclipse, use last-contact method.
translations.idiomatic: if after greatest eclipse, use the last-contact method.

sentences.zh: 求各省日食時刻方位，理同甲子元法。

translations.literal: To find each province's solar-eclipse time and orientation, principle same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To find the time and orientation of the solar eclipse for each province, the principle is the same as in the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 繪日食圖，同甲子元法。

translations.literal: Draw solar-eclipse diagram, same as jiazi epoch method.
translations.idiomatic: To draw the solar eclipse diagram, use the jiazi epoch method.

sentences.zh: 繪日食坤輿圖，取見食極多之分，每分為一限。

translations.literal: Draw solar-eclipse terrestrial map diagram, take the division with the greatest visible eclipse, each division as one tier.
translations.idiomatic: To draw the terrestrial map of a solar eclipse, take the magnitude of greatest visibility and make each unit of magnitude one tier.

sentences.zh: 止於二十一限。

translations.literal: Stopping at twenty-one tiers.
translations.idiomatic: This extends to twenty-one tiers.

sentences.zh: 又取見食時刻早晚，每刻為一限。

translations.literal: Further take early and late times of visible eclipse, each quarter-hour as one tier.
translations.idiomatic: Also take the time of visibility, early or late, with each quarter-hour as one tier.

sentences.zh: 止於九十六限。

translations.literal: Stopping at ninety-six tiers.
translations.idiomatic: This extends to ninety-six tiers.

sentences.zh: 交錯相求，反推得見食各地北極高下度、東西偏度。

translations.literal: Crosswise mutual seeking, reverse deduce visible-eclipse places' polar altitude and east-west deviation.
translations.idiomatic: Cross the two scales and work backward to obtain the polar altitude and east-west deviation for each place of visibility.

sentences.zh: 乃按度聯為一圖。

translations.literal: Then link by degree into one diagram.
translations.idiomatic: Then join the results by degree into a single map.

sentences.zh: 又按坤輿全圖所當高度偏度各地名，遂一填註。

translations.literal: Further according to the full terrestrial map's corresponding altitude and deviation for each place-name, fill in one by one.
translations.idiomatic: Then, using the full terrestrial map, enter each place-name at its corresponding altitude and deviation.

sentences.zh: 相距用數，見月離及五星、恆星行。

translations.literal: Constants for conjunction, see lunar distance and five planets, fixed stars sections.
translations.idiomatic: Constants for close approach: see the sections on lunar distance and the motions of the five planets and fixed stars.

sentences.zh: 推相距法，同甲子元推凌犯法。

translations.literal: Procedure for conjunction, same as jiazi epoch procedure for occultation and conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: The procedure for close approach is the same as the jiazi epoch method for occultation and conjunction.

sentences.zh: 推步用表

translations.literal: Tables for computational astronomy
translations.idiomatic: Tables for computational astronomy

sentences.zh: 甲子元及癸卯元二法，除本法外，皆有用表推算之法，約其大旨著於篇。

translations.literal: Jiazi epoch and guimao epoch two methods, apart from this method, all have table-based computation methods; summarize the main points in this section.
translations.idiomatic: Besides the present method, both the jiazi and guimao epoch systems include table-based procedures; their main features are summarized here.

sentences.zh: 甲子元法：

translations.literal: Jiazi epoch method:
translations.idiomatic: Jiazi epoch method:

sentences.zh: 一曰年根表，以紀年、紀日、值宿為綱，由法元之年順推三百年，各得其年天正冬至次日子正太陽及最卑平行，列為太陽年根表；

translations.literal: First, epoch root tables: using year count, day count, and lodge assignment as framework, from the epoch origin year forward three hundred years, each obtaining that year's civil winter solstice next day midnight sun and perigee mean motions, arranged as solar epoch root table;
translations.idiomatic: First, epoch root tables: keyed by year count, day count, and lodge assignment, extend forward three hundred years from the epoch origin; for each year obtain the sun's mean motion and perigee mean motion at midnight after the civil winter solstice, and tabulate these as the solar epoch root table;

sentences.zh: 太陰及最高、正交平行，列為太陰年根表；

translations.literal: Moon and apogee, true node mean motions, arranged as lunar epoch root table;
translations.idiomatic: the moon's mean motion together with apogee and true-node mean motions, tabulated as the lunar epoch root table;

sentences.zh: 五星及最高、正交、伏見諸平行，為各星年根表。

translations.literal: Five planets and apogee, true node, visibility mean motions, as each planet's epoch root table.
translations.idiomatic: and the five planets' mean motions together with apogee, true node, and visibility values, each as a planetary epoch root table.

sentences.zh: 一曰周歲平行表，以日數為綱，由一日至三百六十六日，積累日、月、五星及最卑、最高、正交、伏見諸平行，各列為周歲平行表。

translations.literal: First, tropical-year mean-motion tables: using day count as framework, from one day to three hundred sixty-six days, accumulate sun, moon, five planets and perigee, apogee, true node, visibility mean motions, each arranged as tropical-year mean-motion table.
translations.idiomatic: Second, tropical-year mean-motion tables: keyed by day count from 1 to 366, accumulate the mean motions of the sun, moon, five planets, and their perigee, apogee, true node, and visibility values, each tabulated separately.

sentences.zh: 一曰周日平行表，以時分秒為綱，與度分秒對列三層，自一至六十，積累日、月、五星及最高、正交、伏見、月距日、太陰引數、交周諸平行，各列為周日平行表。

translations.literal: First, diurnal mean-motion tables: using hours, minutes, seconds as framework, paired with degrees, minutes, seconds in three tiers, from one to sixty, accumulate sun, moon, five planets and apogee, true node, visibility, moon-sun distance, lunar anomaly, nodal cycle mean motions, each arranged as diurnal mean-motion table.
translations.idiomatic: Third, diurnal mean-motion tables: keyed by hours, minutes, and seconds and paired in three tiers with degrees, minutes, and seconds from 1 to 60, accumulate the mean motions of the sun, moon, five planets, apogee, true node, visibility, moon-sun distance, lunar anomaly, and nodal cycle, each tabulated separately.

sentences.zh: 一曰均數表，以引數為綱，豫推得逐度逐分盈縮遲疾，備列於表。

translations.literal: First, equation tables: using anomaly as framework, pre-compute degree-by-degree and minute-by-minute excess-deficit fast-slow, fully arranged in tables.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, equation tables: keyed by anomaly, pre-compute the fast-slow variation for each degree and minute and tabulate the results.

sentences.zh: 太陰別有二三均數表，以引數及月距日為綱，縱橫對列，推得二三均數，備列於表。

translations.literal: Moon separately has second-and-third equation tables, using anomaly and moon-sun distance as framework, crosswise paired, compute second-and-third equations, fully arranged in tables.
translations.idiomatic: The moon has separate second- and third-equation tables keyed by anomaly and moon-sun distance, arranged in crosswise pairs.

sentences.zh: 土、木、金、水四星，則以初均及中分、次均及較分，同列為一表。

translations.literal: Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, Mercury four planets, then first equation and middle term, second equation and correction term, same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: For Saturn, Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury, the first equation and middle term together with the second equation and correction term are combined in one table.

sentences.zh: 火星則以初均及次輪心距地數、次輪半徑本數、太陽高卑差數，同列為一表。

translations.literal: Mars then first equation and epicycle-center geocentric distance, epicycle semidiameter base number, sun high-low difference, same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars, the first equation together with the epicycle-center geocentric distance, epicycle radius, and solar distance variation are combined in one table.

sentences.zh: 皆為均數表。

translations.literal: All are equation tables.
translations.idiomatic: These are all equation tables.

sentences.zh: 一曰距度表，以黃道宮度為綱，列所對赤道南北距緯，為黃赤距度表。

translations.literal: First, latitude-distance tables: using ecliptic mansion degree as framework, list corresponding equator north-south latitude distance, as ecliptic-equator latitude-distance table.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, latitude-distance tables: keyed by ecliptic mansion degree, list the corresponding north-south equatorial latitude distance as the ecliptic-equator latitude-distance table.

sentences.zh: 以月距正交為綱，分黃白大距為六限，列所對黃道南北距緯，為黃白距度表。

translations.literal: Using moon's distance from true node as framework, divide great ecliptic-lunar distance into six tiers, list corresponding ecliptic north-south latitude distance, as ecliptic-lunar latitude-distance table.
translations.idiomatic: Keyed by the moon's distance from the true node and divided into six tiers of great ecliptic-lunar distance, list the corresponding north-south ecliptic latitude distance as the ecliptic-lunar latitude-distance table.

sentences.zh: 一曰升度表，以黃道宮度為綱，列所對赤道度，為黃赤升度表。

translations.literal: First, right-ascension tables: using ecliptic mansion degree as framework, list corresponding equator degree, as ecliptic-equator right-ascension table.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, right-ascension tables: keyed by ecliptic mansion degree, list the corresponding equatorial degree as the ecliptic-equator right-ascension table.

sentences.zh: 一曰黃道赤經交角表，以黃道宮度為綱，取所對黃道赤經交角列於表。

translations.literal: First, ecliptic right-ascension nodal-angle table: using ecliptic mansion degree as framework, take corresponding ecliptic right-ascension nodal angle arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, ecliptic right-ascension angle table: keyed by ecliptic mansion degree, list the corresponding ecliptic right-ascension angle.

sentences.zh: 一曰升度差表，以月、五星距交宮度為綱，各列所當黃道度之較，各為升度差表。

translations.literal: First, right-ascension difference tables: using moon, five planets' distance-from-node mansion degree as framework, each list corresponding ecliptic degree difference, each as right-ascension difference table.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, right-ascension difference tables: keyed by the moon's and five planets' distance from the node in mansion degrees, list the corresponding ecliptic degree correction for each body.

sentences.zh: 一曰時差表，以黃道為綱，取所當赤道度之較變時，列為升度時差表。

translations.literal: First, time-equation tables: using ecliptic as framework, take corresponding equator degree difference converted to time, arranged as right-ascension time-equation table.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, time-equation tables: keyed by ecliptic degree, convert the corresponding equatorial degree difference to time and tabulate it as the right-ascension time-equation table.

sentences.zh: 又以引數為綱，取所當均數變時，列為均數時差表。

translations.literal: Further using anomaly as framework, take corresponding equation converted to time, arranged as equation time-equation table.
translations.idiomatic: Also keyed by anomaly, convert the corresponding equation to time and tabulate it as the equation time-equation table.

sentences.zh: 一曰地半徑差表，以實高度為綱，取所當太陽、太陰及火、金、水三星諸地半徑差，各列為表。

translations.literal: First, diurnal-parallax tables: using true altitude as framework, take corresponding sun, moon and Mars, Venus, Mercury diurnal parallaxes, each arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, diurnal-parallax tables: keyed by true altitude, list the corresponding diurnal parallax for the sun, moon, Mars, Venus, and Mercury.

sentences.zh: 一曰清蒙氣差表，以實高度為綱，取所當清蒙氣差，列為表。

translations.literal: First, refraction tables: using true altitude as framework, take corresponding refraction, arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh, refraction tables: keyed by true altitude, list the corresponding atmospheric refraction.

sentences.zh: 一曰實行表，以引數為綱，取所當太陽、太陰及月距日實行，各列為表。

translations.literal: First, true-motion tables: using anomaly as framework, take corresponding sun, moon and moon-sun distance true motions, each arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth, true-motion tables: keyed by anomaly, list the corresponding true motions of the sun, moon, and moon-sun distance.

sentences.zh: 一曰交均距限表，以月距日為綱，取所當之交均及距限，同列為一表。

translations.literal: First, nodal-equation and limit-distance table: using moon-sun distance as framework, take corresponding nodal equation and limit distance, same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth, nodal-equation and limit-distance table: keyed by moon-sun distance, list the corresponding nodal equation and limit distance together.

sentences.zh: 一曰首朔諸根表，以紀年、紀日、值宿為綱，由法元之年順推三百年，取所當之首朔日時分秒及太陽平行，太陽、太陰引數，太陰交周，五者同列為一表。

translations.literal: First, first-new-moon root tables: using year count, day count, lodge assignment as framework, from epoch origin year forward three hundred years, take corresponding first-new-moon day hour minute second and solar mean motion, solar and lunar anomaly, lunar nodal cycle, five items same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth, first-new-moon root tables: keyed by year count, day count, and lodge assignment, extend forward three hundred years from the epoch origin; for each year list the first new moon's date and time, solar mean motion, solar and lunar anomaly, and lunar nodal cycle in one table.

sentences.zh: 一曰朔望策表，以月數為綱，自一至十三，取所當之朔、望策及太陽平行朔、望策，太陽、太陰引數朔、望策，太陰交周朔、望策，十事同列為一表。

translations.literal: First, new-full-moon tabulation tables: using month count as framework, from one to thirteen, take corresponding new and full moon tabulations and solar mean-motion new-full tabulations, solar and lunar anomaly new-full tabulations, lunar nodal-cycle new-full tabulations, ten items same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth, new- and full-moon tabulation tables: keyed by month count from 1 to 13, list the new- and full-moon tabulations together with solar mean motion, solar and lunar anomaly, and lunar nodal cycle at new and full moon—ten items in one table.

sentences.zh: 一曰視半徑表，以引數為綱，取所當之日半徑、月半徑、月距地影半徑、影差，五者同列為一表。

translations.literal: First, apparent-semidiameter tables: using anomaly as framework, take corresponding sun semidiameter, moon semidiameter, moon distance from earth-shadow semidiameter, shadow difference, five items same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteenth, apparent-semidiameter tables: keyed by anomaly, list the solar semidiameter, lunar semidiameter, lunar distance from the earth-shadow semidiameter, and shadow correction together.

sentences.zh: 一曰交食月行表，以食甚距緯分為綱，自初分至六十四分，與太陽、太陰、地影，凡兩半徑之和分，自二十五分至六十四分，縱橫對列，取所當之月行分秒列為表。

translations.literal: First, eclipse lunar-motion tables: using greatest-eclipse latitude-distance minutes as framework, from first minute to sixty-four minutes, with sun, moon, earth-shadow, all two-semidiameter sum minutes from twenty-five minutes to sixty-four minutes, crosswise paired, take corresponding lunar-motion minutes arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth, eclipse lunar-motion tables: keyed by latitude distance at greatest eclipse from 1 to 64 minutes and crosswise paired with the sum of the two semidiameters of the sun, moon, and earth shadow from 25 to 64 minutes, list the corresponding lunar motion in minutes and seconds.

sentences.zh: 其太陰、地影兩半徑之較分與和分同用。

translations.literal: The moon and earth-shadow two-semidiameter difference minutes and sum minutes are used the same.
translations.idiomatic: The difference and sum of the lunar and earth-shadow semidiameters are used interchangeably.

sentences.zh: 一曰黃平象限表，以正午黃道宮度為綱，分北極高自十六度至四十六度為三十一限，取所當之春分距午、黃平象限、限距地高，三者同列為一表。

translations.literal: First, ecliptic horizon-quadrant tables: using noon ecliptic mansion degree as framework, divide polar altitude from sixteen degrees to forty-six degrees into thirty-one tiers, take corresponding vernal-equinox meridian distance, ecliptic horizon quadrant, limit geocentric altitude, three items same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteenth, ecliptic horizon-quadrant tables: keyed by the ecliptic mansion degree at noon and polar altitude from 16° to 46° in thirty-one tiers, list the vernal-equinox meridian distance, ecliptic horizon quadrant, and limit geocentric altitude together.

sentences.zh: 一曰黃道高弧交角表、以日距限為綱，自初度至九十度，分限距地高自二十度至八十九度為七十限，取所當之黃道高弧交角列為表。

translations.literal: First, ecliptic altitude-arc nodal-angle table: using sun limit distance as framework, from initial degree to ninety degrees, divide limit geocentric altitude from twenty degrees to eighty-nine degrees into seventy tiers, take corresponding ecliptic altitude-arc nodal angle arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteenth, ecliptic altitude-arc angle table: keyed by solar limit distance from 0° to 90° and limit geocentric altitude from 20° to 89° in seventy tiers, list the corresponding ecliptic altitude-arc angle.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陽高弧表，列法與黃道高弧交角表同。

translations.literal: First, solar altitude-arc table, arrangement method same as ecliptic altitude-arc nodal-angle table.
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth, solar altitude-arc table: arranged by the same method as the ecliptic altitude-arc angle table.

sentences.zh: 一曰東西南北差表，以交角度為綱，自初度至九十度，與高下差一分至六十三分，縱橫對列，取所當之東西差及南北差，同列為表。

translations.literal: First, east-west and north-south difference tables: using nodal angle as framework, from initial degree to ninety degrees, with altitude-parallax difference from one minute to sixty-three minutes crosswise paired, take corresponding east-west difference and north-south difference, same column as table.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-first, east-west and north-south difference tables: keyed by nodal angle from 0° to 90° and crosswise paired with altitude-parallax difference from 1 to 63 minutes, list the corresponding east-west and north-south differences.

sentences.zh: 一曰緯差角表，以並徑為綱，自三十一分至六十四分，與距緯一分至六十四分，縱橫對列，取所當之緯差角列為表。

translations.literal: First, latitude-difference angle tables: using combined diameter as framework, from thirty-one minutes to sixty-four minutes, with latitude distance from one minute to sixty-four minutes crosswise paired, take corresponding latitude-difference angle arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-second, latitude-difference angle tables: keyed by combined diameter from 31 to 64 minutes and crosswise paired with latitude distance from 1 to 64 minutes, list the corresponding latitude-difference angle.

sentences.zh: 一曰星距黃道表，以距交宮度為綱，取所當星距黃道數各列為表，水星獨分交角自四度五十五分三十二秒至六度三十一分二秒為二十限。

translations.literal: First, star ecliptic-distance tables: using distance-from-node mansion degree as framework, take corresponding star ecliptic-distance numbers each arranged as table; Mercury alone divides nodal angle from 4°55′32″ to 6°31′2″ into twenty tiers.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-third, star ecliptic-distance tables: keyed by distance from the node in mansion degrees, list each star's ecliptic distance; for Mercury alone, divide the nodal angle from 4°55′32″ to 6°31′2″ into twenty tiers.

sentences.zh: 一曰星距地表，以星距日宮度為綱，取所當之星距地列於表。

translations.literal: First, star geocentric-distance tables: using star's distance-from-sun mansion degree as framework, take corresponding star geocentric distance arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-fourth, star geocentric-distance tables: keyed by the star's distance from the sun in mansion degrees, list the corresponding geocentric distance.

sentences.zh: 一曰水星距限表，以距交宮度為綱，取所當之距限列為表。

translations.literal: First, Mercury limit-distance table: using distance-from-node mansion degree as framework, take corresponding limit distance arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-fifth, Mercury limit-distance table: keyed by distance from the node in mansion degrees, list the corresponding limit distance.

sentences.zh: 一曰五星伏見距日黃道度表，以星行黃道經表為綱，分晨夕上下列之，取各星所當距日黃道度，同列為一表。

translations.literal: First, five-planet visibility solar ecliptic-degree tables: using planetary ecliptic-longitude tables as framework, divide morning and evening upper and lower arranged, take each planet's corresponding solar ecliptic distance, same column as one table.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-sixth, five-planet heliacal visibility solar ecliptic-degree tables: keyed by the planetary ecliptic-longitude tables and divided into morning and evening, upper and lower positions, list each planet's corresponding solar ecliptic distance.

sentences.zh: 一曰五星伏見距日加減差表，列法同黃道度表，但不分五星，別黃道南北自一度至八度。

translations.literal: First, five-planet visibility solar add-subtract difference tables, arrangement method same as ecliptic-degree tables, but not divided by five planets, separately ecliptic north-south from one degree to eight degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seventh, five-planet heliacal visibility solar correction tables: arranged like the ecliptic-degree tables, but without separating the five planets and instead dividing ecliptic latitude from 1° to 8° north and south.

sentences.zh: 癸卯元法所增：

translations.literal: Guimao epoch method additions:
translations.idiomatic: Additions in the guimao epoch method:

sentences.zh: 一曰太陽距地心表，以太陽實引為綱，取所對之太陽距地心真數對數，並列於表。

translations.literal: First, solar geocentric-distance table: using solar true anomaly as framework, take corresponding solar geocentric-distance true number and logarithm, both arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: First, solar geocentric-distance table: keyed by true solar anomaly, list the corresponding true geocentric distance and its logarithm.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰一平均表，以太陽引數為綱，取所當之太陰一平均、最高平均、正交平均，並列於表。

translations.literal: First, lunar first mean-motion table: using solar anomaly as framework, take corresponding lunar first mean motion, apogee mean motion, true-node mean motion, both arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Second, lunar first mean-motion table: keyed by solar anomaly, list the corresponding first lunar mean motion together with apogee and true-node mean motions.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰二平均表，以日距月最高宮度為綱，取所當太陽在最高之二平均及高卑較秒，並列於表。

translations.literal: First, lunar second mean-motion table: using sun's distance from lunar apogee mansion degree as framework, take corresponding sun at apogee second mean motion and high-low comparison seconds, both arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Third, lunar second mean-motion table: keyed by the sun's distance from the lunar apogee in mansion degrees, list the second mean motion when the sun is at apogee together with the distance variation in seconds.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰三平均表，以月距正交宮度為綱，取所當之三平均列為表。

translations.literal: First, lunar third mean-motion table: using moon's distance from true node mansion degree as framework, take corresponding third mean motion arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, lunar third mean-motion table: keyed by the moon's distance from the true node in mansion degrees, list the corresponding third mean motion.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰最高均及本天心距地表，以日距月天最高宮度為綱，取所當最高均及本天心距地數，並列於表。

translations.literal: First, lunar apogee equation and deferent-center geocentric-distance table: using sun's distance from lunar celestial apogee mansion degree as framework, take corresponding apogee equation and deferent-center geocentric distance, both arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, lunar apogee equation and deferent-center geocentric-distance table: keyed by the sun's distance from the lunar celestial apogee in mansion degrees, list the apogee equation and deferent-center geocentric distance.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰二均表，以月距日宮度為綱，取所當太陽在最高時二均及高卑較數，並列於表。

translations.literal: First, lunar second-equation table: using moon's distance-from-sun mansion degree as framework, take corresponding sun at apogee second equation and high-low comparison number, both arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, lunar second-equation table: keyed by the moon's distance from the sun in mansion degrees, list the second equation when the sun is at apogee together with the distance variation.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰三均表，以相距總數為綱，取所對之三均列於表。

translations.literal: First, lunar third-equation table: using conjunction total number as framework, take corresponding third equation arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, lunar third-equation table: keyed by the total conjunction number, list the corresponding third equation.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰末均表，以實月距日宮度為綱，與日月最高相距，縱橫對列，取所當之末均列為表。

translations.literal: First, lunar final-equation table: using true moon-sun distance mansion degree as framework, with sun-moon apogee separation crosswise paired, take corresponding final equation arranged as table.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, lunar final-equation table: keyed by true moon-sun distance in mansion degrees and crosswise paired with sun-moon apogee separation, list the corresponding final equation.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰正交實均表，以日距正交宮度為綱，取所對之正交實均列為表。

translations.literal: First, lunar true-node true-equation table: using sun's distance from true node mansion degree as framework, take corresponding true-node true equation arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth, lunar true-node true-equation table: keyed by the sun's distance from the true node in mansion degrees, list the corresponding true-node equation.

sentences.zh: 一曰交角加分表，以日距正交宮度為綱，取所當之距交加分加差，並列於表。

translations.literal: First, nodal-angle addition table: using sun's distance from true node mansion degree as framework, take corresponding distance-from-node addition and correction, both arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth, nodal-angle addition table: keyed by the sun's distance from the true node in mansion degrees, list the corresponding nodal addition and correction.

sentences.zh: 一曰黃白距緯表，列法與升度差表同。

translations.literal: First, ecliptic-lunar latitude-distance table, arrangement method same as right-ascension difference table.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh, ecliptic-lunar latitude-distance table: arranged by the same method as the right-ascension difference table.

sentences.zh: 一曰太陰距地心表，以太陰實引為綱，取所當最大、最小兩心差各太陰距地心數及倍分，並列於表。

translations.literal: First, lunar geocentric-distance table: using lunar true anomaly as framework, take corresponding maximum and minimum two-center-difference each lunar geocentric-distance numbers and double minutes, both arranged in table.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth, lunar geocentric-distance table: keyed by true lunar anomaly, list the geocentric distance and double minutes for the maximum and minimum two-center differences.

sentences.zh: 其名同而實異者，太陰初均表分大、中、小三限，黃、白升度差表列最小交角及大、小較秒，太陰地半徑差表、太陰實行表俱分大、小二限。

translations.literal: Those same in name but different in substance: lunar first-equation table divided into large, middle, small three tiers; ecliptic and lunar right-ascension difference tables list minimum nodal angle and large, small comparison seconds; lunar diurnal-parallax and lunar true-motion tables both divided into large, small two tiers.
translations.idiomatic: Tables that share a name but differ in content: the lunar first-equation table is divided into large, middle, and small tiers; the ecliptic- and lunar right-ascension difference tables list the minimum nodal angle and large and small comparison seconds; the lunar diurnal-parallax and true-motion tables are each divided into large and small tiers.

sentences.zh: 求太陽太陰距地，用平三角形，以日躔倍兩心差為對正角之邊，以太陽實引為又一角，三宮內用本度，過三宮與六宮相減，過九宮與全周相減，用其餘。

translations.literal: To find sun and moon geocentric distance, use plane triangle, solar motion double two-center difference as side opposite right angle, solar true anomaly as another angle, within three mansions use original degree, past three mansions subtract six mansions, past nine mansions subtract full circle, use the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sun's and moon's geocentric distance, by plane triangle: take the solar double eccentricity as the side opposite the right angle and the true solar anomaly as the other angle; within three mansions use the degree as given, beyond three mansions subtract six mansions, beyond nine mansions subtract the full circle, and use the remainder.

sentences.zh: 求得對太陽實引之邊為勾。

translations.literal: The side obtained opposite solar true anomaly is the base leg.
translations.idiomatic: The side opposite the true solar anomaly is the base leg.

sentences.zh: 又求得對原不知角之邊為分股，與二千萬相加減，實引三宮內九宮外加，三宮外九宮內減。

translations.literal: Further the side obtained opposite the originally unknown angle is the fractional leg, add-subtract with twenty million; true anomaly within three mansions and outside nine mansions add, outside three mansions and within nine mansions subtract.
translations.idiomatic: The side opposite the originally unknown angle is the fractional leg; add or subtract it from 20,000,000—add when true anomaly is within three mansions or beyond nine mansions, subtract between three and nine mansions.

sentences.zh: 為股弦和與勾，求得股。

translations.literal: As leg-hypotenuse sum with base leg, obtain leg.
translations.idiomatic: With the sum of the leg and hypotenuse and the base leg, find the leg.

sentences.zh: 與分股相加減，實引三宮內九宮外減，三宮外九宮內加。

translations.literal: Add-subtract with fractional leg, true anomaly within three mansions and outside nine mansions subtract, outside three mansions and within nine mansions add.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the fractional leg—subtract when true anomaly is within three mansions or beyond nine mansions, add between three and nine mansions.

sentences.zh: 得太陽距地。

translations.literal: Obtain sun geocentric distance.
translations.idiomatic: This yields the sun's geocentric distance.

sentences.zh: 又以實望月離倍兩心差如法求之，得太陰距地。

translations.literal: Further with true full moon moon's distance double two-center difference by same method seek it, obtain moon geocentric distance.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the same method using the moon's double eccentricity at true full moon to obtain the moon's geocentric distance.
